---
title: "IDE- und SDK-Kompatibilität"
description: "Vollständige Kompatibilitätsreferenz für KI-Programmiertools, SDKs und Frameworks"
---

## Übersicht

Die LemonData API ist für eine **Plug-and-Play-Kompatibilität** mit allen gängigen KI-Entwicklungstools konzipiert. Dieser Leitfaden dokumentiert die unterstützten Parameter und verifizierten Integrationen.

<Note>
  Alle Parameter werden validiert und an die Upstream-Provider durchgereicht. Parameter, die von einem bestimmten Modell nicht unterstützt werden, werden stillschweigend ignoriert, um maximale Kompatibilität zu gewährleisten.
</Note>

## Unterstützte API-Formate

| Endpunkt | Format | Anwendungsfall |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | Allgemeine Kompatibilität |
| `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | Stateful Conversations |
| `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | Claude-native Funktionen |
| `/v1beta/models/:model:generateContent` | Google Gemini | Gemini-native Funktionen |

## IDE- und CLI-Kompatibilität

### Verifizierte Tools

| Tool | Status | Format | Anmerkungen |
|------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Cursor** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | OpenAI | Unterstützt Anthropic-Tool-Format |
| **Claude Code CLI** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | Anthropic | Unterstützt Extended thinking, tool_choice |
| **Windsurf** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | OpenAI | Standard-OpenAI-Format |
| **Aider** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | OpenAI | Unterstützt alle Modelle |
| **Continue.dev** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | OpenAI/Anthropic | Unterstützung beider Formate |
| **OpenCode** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | OpenAI | Multi-Provider-Unterstützung |
| **Cline/Roo Code** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | OpenAI | Über OpenRouter-Format |
| **GitHub Copilot** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | OpenAI | Standardformat |
| **Codex CLI** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | OpenAI | OpenAI Responses API |
| **Gemini CLI** | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | Gemini | Natives Gemini-Format |

### Konfigurationsbeispiele

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Cursor">
    ```
    Base URL: https://api.lemondata.cc/v1
    API Key: sk-your-lemondata-key
    ```
    Cursor verwendet intern das Tool-Format im Anthropic-Stil. LemonData unterstützt beide folgenden Formate:
    - OpenAI-Format: `{ type: "function", function: { name, parameters } }`
    - Anthropic-Format: `{ name, input_schema }` (ohne type-Feld)
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Claude Code">
    ```bash
    export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.lemondata.cc"
    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="OpenCode">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export LOCAL_ENDPOINT="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Aider">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export OPENAI_API_BASE="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    aider --model gpt-4o
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## SDK-Kompatibilität

### Verifizierte SDKs

| SDK | Sprache | Status | Anmerkungen |
|-----|----------|--------|-------|
| **OpenAI SDK** | Python/JS/Go | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | Unterstützt alle Parameter |
| **Anthropic SDK** | Python/JS | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | Unterstützt Extended thinking, tools |
| **Vercel AI SDK** | TypeScript | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | Unterstützt streamText, generateObject |
| **LangChain** | Python/JS | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | Unterstützt ChatOpenAI, bind_tools |
| **LlamaIndex** | Python | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | Kompatibel mit OpenAI |
| **Dify** | - | ✅ Vollständig unterstützt | OpenAI-Format |

## Chat Completions Parameter

### Kernparameter

| Parameter | Typ | Beschreibung |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Modell-ID (erforderlich) |
| `messages` | array | Konversationsnachrichten (erforderlich) |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Maximale Anzahl an Output-Tokens |
| `temperature` | number | Sampling-Temperatur (0-2) |
| `top_p` | number | Nucleus-Sampling (0-1) |
| `stream` | boolean | Streaming aktivieren |

### Tool-Aufrufe

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "Get weather for a location",
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "location": { "type": "string" }
          }
        },
        "strict": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": "auto",
  "parallel_tool_calls": true
}
```

### Optionen für die Tool-Auswahl

| Format | Beispiel | Beschreibung |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| String | `"auto"`, `"none"`, `"required"` | Einfache Auswahl |
| OpenAI Object | `{ "type": "function", "function": { "name": "fn" } }` | Erzwingen einer bestimmten Funktion |
| Anthropic Object | `{ "type": "tool", "name": "fn", "disable_parallel_tool_use": true }` | Natives Anthropic-Format |

### Erweiterte Parameter

| Parameter | Typ | Beschreibung |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `stream_options` | object | Verwendet `{ include_usage: true }` zum Abrufen der Token-Anzahl |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | Verfügbar für o1/o3 Modelle: `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"` |
| `service_tier` | string | `"auto"` oder `"default"` |
| `seed` | integer | Deterministische Ausgabe |
| `logprobs` | boolean | Log-Wahrscheinlichkeiten zurückgeben |
| `top_logprobs` | integer | Anzahl der höchsten Log-Wahrscheinlichkeiten (0-20) |
| `logit_bias` | object | Token-Bias-Mapping (-100 bis 100) |
| `frequency_penalty` | number | Wiederholungsstrafe (-2 bis 2) |
| `presence_penalty` | number | Präsenzstrafe (-2 bis 2) |
| `stop` | string/array | Stop-Sequenzen |
| `n` | integer | Anzahl der generierten Ergebnisse (1-128) |
| `user` | string | Benutzer-ID zur Nachverfolgung |

### Erweiterte OpenAI-Funktionen

| Parameter | Typ | Beschreibung |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `modalities` | array | Verwendet `["text", "audio"]` für Multimodalität |
| `audio` | object | Audio-Ausgabekonfiguration (Stimme, Format) |
| `prediction` | object | Vorhergesagte Ausgabe zur Beschleunigung der Generierung |
| `metadata` | object | Key-Value-Paare zur Nachverfolgung |
| `store` | boolean | Speichern für späteren Abruf |

### Anbieterspezifische Optionen

```json
{
  "anthropic_options": {
    "thinking": {
      "type": "enabled",
      "budget_tokens": 10000
    },
    "prompt_caching": true
  },
  "google_options": {
    "safety_settings": [...],
    "google_search": true,
    "code_execution": true
  }
}
```

## Anthropic Messages Parameter

### Kernparameter

| Parameter | Typ | Beschreibung |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Modell-ID |
| `messages` | array | Konversationsnachrichten |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Maximaler Output (bis zu 128.000) |
| `system` | string/array | System-Prompt |
| `stream` | boolean | Streaming aktivieren |

### Tool-Aufrufe

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get weather",
      "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "location": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": {
    "type": "auto",
    "disable_parallel_tool_use": false
  }
}
```

### Erweitertes Denken (Extended Thinking)

```json
{
  "model": "claude-opus-4-5",
  "thinking": {
    "type": "enabled",
    "budget_tokens": 10000
  }
}
```

## Responses API Parameter

### Kernparameter

| Parameter | Typ | Beschreibung |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Modell-ID |
| `input` | string/array | Eingabeinhalt |
| `instructions` | string | Systemanweisungen |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | Maximale Anzahl an Output-Tokens |
| `previous_response_id` | string | Konversation fortsetzen |

### Erweiterte Parameter

| Parameter | Typ | Beschreibung |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `truncation_strategy` | string | `"auto"` oder `"disabled"` |
| `include` | array | `["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | Verfügbar für Reasoning-Modelle |
| `service_tier` | string | Prioritätsstufe |

### Tool-Formate

Unterstützt sowohl das OpenAI- als auch das Anthropic-Tool-Format:

```json
// OpenAI-Format
{ "type": "function", "name": "fn", "parameters": {...} }

// Anthropic-Format (Cursor-kompatibel)
{ "name": "fn", "input_schema": {...} }
```

## Gemini API Parameter

### Kernparameter

| Parameter | Typ | Beschreibung |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `contents` | array | Konversationsinhalt |
| `systemInstruction` | object | System-Prompt |
| `generationConfig` | object | Generierungskonfiguration |

### Tools

```json
{
  "tools": [{
    "functionDeclarations": [{
      "name": "search",
      "description": "Search the web",
      "parameters": {...}
    }],
    "codeExecution": {},
    "googleSearch": {}
  }],
  "toolConfig": {
    "functionCallingConfig": {
      "mode": "AUTO"
    }
  }
}
```

### Sicherheitseinstellungen

```json
{
  "safetySettings": [
    {
      "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
      "threshold": "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Zusätzliche Parameter

| Parameter | Typ | Beschreibung |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `cachedContent` | string | Referenz auf gecachten Inhalt |
| `responseMimeType` | string | `"text/plain"` oder `"application/json"` |
| `responseSchema` | object | JSON-Schema für strukturierte Ausgabe |

## Streaming

Alle Endpunkte unterstützen Server-Sent Events (SSE) Streaming:

```bash
# Chat Completions
curl https://api.lemondata.cc/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [...], "stream": true}'

# Mit Nutzungsverfolgung
-d '{"...", "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}}'
```

## Fehlerbehandlung

LemonData gibt OpenAI-kompatible Fehlermeldungen zurück:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid API key",
    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

Weitere Details finden Sie im [Leitfaden zur Fehlerbehandlung](/guides/error-handling).

## Best Practices

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Passthrough für unbekannte Parameter verwenden">
    Alle Schemata verwenden `.passthrough()` – unbekannte Parameter werden an den Upstream-Provider weitergeleitet.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Bevorzugen Sie stream_options für eine präzise Abrechnung">
    Aktivieren Sie `stream_options.include_usage`, um genaue Token-Anzahlen in Streaming-Antworten zu erhalten.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Verwenden Sie das passende tool_choice-Format">
    Bitte passen Sie das Format an die Erwartungen Ihres SDKs an. LemonData akzeptiert sowohl das OpenAI- als auch das Anthropic-Format.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

---
title: "Compatibilité IDE et SDK"
description: "Référence complète de compatibilité pour les outils de programmation IA, les SDK et les frameworks"
---

## Aperçu

L'API LemonData est conçue pour une **compatibilité plug-and-play** avec tous les principaux outils de développement IA. Ce guide documente les paramètres pris en charge et les intégrations vérifiées.

<Note>
  Tous les paramètres sont validés et transmis aux fournisseurs en amont. Les paramètres non pris en charge par des modèles spécifiques seront ignorés silencieusement pour garantir une compatibilité maximale.
</Note>

## Formats d'API pris en charge

| Endpoint | Format | Cas d'utilisation |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | Compatibilité générale |
| `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | Conversations avec état |
| `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | Fonctionnalités natives Claude |
| `/v1beta/models/:model:generateContent` | Google Gemini | Fonctionnalités natives Gemini |

## Compatibilité IDE et CLI

### Outils vérifiés

| Outil | Statut | Format | Remarques |
|------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Cursor** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | OpenAI | Prend en charge le format d'outils Anthropic |
| **Claude Code CLI** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | Anthropic | Prend en charge `Extended thinking`, `tool_choice` |
| **Windsurf** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | OpenAI | Format OpenAI standard |
| **Aider** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | OpenAI | Prend en charge tous les modèles |
| **Continue.dev** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | OpenAI/Anthropic | Prise en charge du double format |
| **OpenCode** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | OpenAI | Prise en charge multi-fournisseurs |
| **Cline/Roo Code** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | OpenAI | Via le format OpenRouter |
| **GitHub Copilot** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | OpenAI | Format standard |
| **Codex CLI** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | OpenAI | OpenAI Responses API |
| **Gemini CLI** | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | Gemini | Format Gemini natif |

### Exemples de configuration

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Cursor">
    ```
    Base URL: https://api.lemondata.cc/v1
    API Key: sk-your-lemondata-key
    ```
    Cursor utilise en interne le format d'outils de style Anthropic. LemonData prend en charge les deux formats suivants :
    - Format OpenAI : `{ type: "function", function: { name, parameters } }`
    - Format Anthropic : `{ name, input_schema }` (sans champ `type`)
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Claude Code">
    ```bash
    export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.lemondata.cc"
    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="OpenCode">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export LOCAL_ENDPOINT="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Aider">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export OPENAI_API_BASE="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    aider --model gpt-4o
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Compatibilité SDK

### SDK vérifiés

| SDK | Langage | Statut | Remarques |
|-----|----------|--------|-------|
| **OpenAI SDK** | Python/JS/Go | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | Prend en charge tous les paramètres |
| **Anthropic SDK** | Python/JS | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | Prend en charge `Extended thinking`, `tools` |
| **Vercel AI SDK** | TypeScript | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | Prend en charge `streamText`, `generateObject` |
| **LangChain** | Python/JS | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | Prend en charge `ChatOpenAI`, `bind_tools` |
| **LlamaIndex** | Python | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | Compatible avec OpenAI |
| **Dify** | - | ✅ Entièrement pris en charge | Format OpenAI |

## Paramètres Chat Completions

### Paramètres de base

| Paramètre | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identifiant du modèle (requis) |
| `messages` | array | Messages de conversation (requis) |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Nombre maximum de tokens de sortie |
| `temperature` | number | Température d'échantillonnage (0-2) |
| `top_p` | number | Échantillonnage nucléaire (0-1) |
| `stream` | boolean | Activer le streaming |

### Appel d'outils

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "Get weather for a location",
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "location": { "type": "string" }
          }
        },
        "strict": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": "auto",
  "parallel_tool_calls": true
}
```

### Options de choix d'outils

| Format | Exemple | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| String | `"auto"`, `"none"`, `"required"` | Sélection simple |
| OpenAI Object | `{ "type": "function", "function": { "name": "fn" } }` | Forcer une fonction spécifique |
| Anthropic Object | `{ "type": "tool", "name": "fn", "disable_parallel_tool_use": true }` | Format natif Anthropic |

### Paramètres avancés

| Paramètre | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `stream_options` | object | `{ include_usage: true }` pour obtenir le compte de tokens |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"` pour les modèles o1/o3 |
| `service_tier` | string | `"auto"` ou `"default"` |
| `seed` | integer | Sortie déterministe |
| `logprobs` | boolean | Retourne les log-probabilités |
| `top_logprobs` | integer | Nombre des log-probabilités les plus élevées (0-20) |
| `logit_bias` | object | Mappage de biais de tokens (-100 à 100) |
| `frequency_penalty` | number | Pénalité de fréquence (-2 à 2) |
| `presence_penalty` | number | Pénalité de présence (-2 à 2) |
| `stop` | string/array | Séquences d'arrêt |
| `n` | integer | Nombre de résultats générés (1-128) |
| `user` | string | Identifiant utilisateur pour le suivi |

### Fonctionnalités avancées OpenAI

| Paramètre | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `modalities` | array | `["text", "audio"]` pour le multimodal |
| `audio` | object | Configuration de la sortie audio (voix, format) |
| `prediction` | object | Sortie prédictive pour accélérer la génération |
| `metadata` | object | Paires clé-valeur pour le suivi |
| `store` | boolean | Stocker pour une récupération ultérieure |

### Options spécifiques aux fournisseurs

```json
{
  "anthropic_options": {
    "thinking": {
      "type": "enabled",
      "budget_tokens": 10000
    },
    "prompt_caching": true
  },
  "google_options": {
    "safety_settings": [...],
    "google_search": true,
    "code_execution": true
  }
}
```

## Paramètres Anthropic Messages

### Paramètres de base

| Paramètre | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identifiant du modèle |
| `messages` | array | Messages de conversation |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Sortie maximale (jusqu'à 128000) |
| `system` | string/array | Prompt système |
| `stream` | boolean | Activer le streaming |

### Appel d'outils

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get weather",
      "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "location": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": {
    "type": "auto",
    "disable_parallel_tool_use": false
  }
}
```

### Pensée étendue (Extended Thinking)

```json
{
  "model": "claude-opus-4-5",
  "thinking": {
    "type": "enabled",
    "budget_tokens": 10000
  }
}
```

## Paramètres Responses API

### Paramètres de base

| Paramètre | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identifiant du modèle |
| `input` | string/array | Contenu d'entrée |
| `instructions` | string | Instructions système |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | Nombre maximum de tokens de sortie |
| `previous_response_id` | string | Continuer la conversation |

### Paramètres avancés

| Paramètre | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `truncation_strategy` | string | `"auto"` ou `"disabled"` |
| `include` | array | `["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | Applicable aux modèles de raisonnement |
| `service_tier` | string | Niveau de priorité |

### Format d'outils

Prend en charge les formats d'outils OpenAI et Anthropic :

```json
// Format OpenAI
{ "type": "function", "name": "fn", "parameters": {...} }

// Format Anthropic (compatible Cursor)
{ "name": "fn", "input_schema": {...} }
```

## Paramètres Gemini API

### Paramètres de base

| Paramètre | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `contents` | array | Contenu de la conversation |
| `systemInstruction` | object | Instruction système |
| `generationConfig` | object | Configuration de génération |

### Outils

```json
{
  "tools": [{
    "functionDeclarations": [{
      "name": "search",
      "description": "Search the web",
      "parameters": {...}
    }],
    "codeExecution": {},
    "googleSearch": {}
  }],
  "toolConfig": {
    "functionCallingConfig": {
      "mode": "AUTO"
    }
  }
}
```

### Paramètres de sécurité

```json
{
  "safetySettings": [
    {
      "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
      "threshold": "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Paramètres supplémentaires

| Paramètre | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `cachedContent` | string | Référence au contenu mis en cache |
| `responseMimeType` | string | `"text/plain"` ou `"application/json"` |
| `responseSchema` | object | JSON schema pour une sortie structurée |

## Streaming

Tous les endpoints prennent en charge le streaming via Server-Sent Events (SSE) :

```bash
# Chat Completions
curl https://api.lemondata.cc/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [...], "stream": true}'

# Avec suivi de l'utilisation
-d '{"...", "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}}'
```

## Gestion des erreurs

LemonData retourne des réponses d'erreur compatibles avec OpenAI :

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid API key",
    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

Voir le [guide de gestion des erreurs](/guides/error-handling) pour plus de détails.

## Bonnes pratiques

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Utiliser le transfert pour les paramètres inconnus">
    Tous les schémas utilisent `.passthrough()` — les paramètres inconnus seront transférés au fournisseur en amont.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Privilégier stream_options pour une facturation précise">
    Activez `stream_options.include_usage` pour obtenir un compte de tokens précis dans les réponses en streaming.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Utiliser le format tool_choice approprié">
    Veuillez faire correspondre le format attendu par votre SDK. LemonData accepte à la fois les formats OpenAI et Anthropic.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Resumen

La API de LemonData está diseñada para ofrecer **compatibilidad plug-and-play** con todas las principales herramientas de desarrollo de IA. Esta guía documenta los parámetros soportados y las integraciones verificadas.

<Note>
  Todos los parámetros son validados y transmitidos a los proveedores upstream. Los parámetros no soportados por modelos específicos se ignorarán silenciosamente para garantizar la máxima compatibilidad.
</Note>

## Formatos de API soportados

| Endpoint | Formato | Casos de uso |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | Compatibilidad general |
| `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | Conversaciones con estado |
| `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | Funciones nativas de Claude |
| `/v1beta/models/:model:generateContent` | Google Gemini | Funciones nativas de Gemini |

## Compatibilidad con IDEs y CLIs

### Herramientas verificadas

| Herramienta | Estado | Formato | Notas |
|------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Cursor** | ✅ Soporte completo | OpenAI | Soporta formato de herramientas de Anthropic |
| **Claude Code CLI** | ✅ Soporte completo | Anthropic | Soporta Extended thinking, tool_choice |
| **Windsurf** | ✅ Soporte completo | OpenAI | Formato estándar de OpenAI |
| **Aider** | ✅ Soporte completo | OpenAI | Soporta todos los modelos |
| **Continue.dev** | ✅ Soporte completo | OpenAI/Anthropic | Soporte de formato dual |
| **OpenCode** | ✅ Soporte completo | OpenAI | Soporte para múltiples proveedores |
| **Cline/Roo Code** | ✅ Soporte completo | OpenAI | A través del formato de OpenRouter |
| **GitHub Copilot** | ✅ Soporte completo | OpenAI | Formato estándar |
| **Codex CLI** | ✅ Soporte completo | OpenAI | OpenAI Responses API |
| **Gemini CLI** | ✅ Soporte completo | Gemini | Formato nativo de Gemini |

### Ejemplos de configuración

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Cursor">
    ```
    Base URL: https://api.lemondata.cc/v1
    API Key: sk-your-lemondata-key
    ```
    Cursor utiliza internamente el formato de herramientas al estilo de Anthropic. LemonData soporta ambos formatos:
    - Formato OpenAI: `{ type: "function", function: { name, parameters } }`
    - Formato Anthropic: `{ name, input_schema }` (sin campo `type`)
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Claude Code">
    ```bash
    export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.lemondata.cc"
    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="OpenCode">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export LOCAL_ENDPOINT="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Aider">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export OPENAI_API_BASE="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    aider --model gpt-4o
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Compatibilidad con SDKs

### SDKs verificados

| SDK | Lenguaje | Estado | Notas |
|-----|----------|--------|-------|
| **OpenAI SDK** | Python/JS/Go | ✅ Soporte completo | Soporta todos los parámetros |
| **Anthropic SDK** | Python/JS | ✅ Soporte completo | Soporta Extended thinking, tools |
| **Vercel AI SDK** | TypeScript | ✅ Soporte completo | Soporta `streamText`, `generateObject` |
| **LangChain** | Python/JS | ✅ Soporte completo | Soporta `ChatOpenAI`, `bind_tools` |
| **LlamaIndex** | Python | ✅ Soporte completo | Compatible con OpenAI |
| **Dify** | - | ✅ Soporte completo | Formato OpenAI |

## Parámetros de Chat Completions

### Parámetros principales

| Parámetro | Tipo | Descripción |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identificador del modelo (requerido) |
| `messages` | array | Mensajes de conversación (requerido) |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Número máximo de tokens de salida |
| `temperature` | number | Temperatura de muestreo (0-2) |
| `top_p` | number | Muestreo de núcleo (0-1) |
| `stream` | boolean | Habilitar transmisión en streaming |

### Llamadas a herramientas

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "Get weather for a location",
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "location": { "type": "string" }
          }
        },
        "strict": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": "auto",
  "parallel_tool_calls": true
}
```

### Opciones de selección de herramientas

| Formato | Ejemplo | Descripción |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| String | `"auto"`, `"none"`, `"required"` | Selección simple |
| OpenAI Object | `{ "type": "function", "function": { "name": "fn" } }` | Forzar una función específica |
| Anthropic Object | `{ "type": "tool", "name": "fn", "disable_parallel_tool_use": true }` | Formato nativo de Anthropic |

### Parámetros avanzados

| Parámetro | Tipo | Descripción |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `stream_options` | object | `{ include_usage: true }` para obtener el conteo de tokens |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"` aplicable a modelos o1/o3 |
| `service_tier` | string | `"auto"` o `"default"` |
| `seed` | integer | Salida determinista |
| `logprobs` | boolean | Devolver probabilidades logarítmicas |
| `top_logprobs` | integer | Número de las probabilidades logarítmicas más altas (0-20) |
| `logit_bias` | object | Mapeo de sesgo de tokens (-100 a 100) |
| `frequency_penalty` | number | Penalización por frecuencia (-2 a 2) |
| `presence_penalty` | number | Penalización por presencia (-2 a 2) |
| `stop` | string/array | Secuencias de parada |
| `n` | integer | Número de resultados generados (1-128) |
| `user` | string | Identificador de usuario para seguimiento |

### Funciones avanzadas de OpenAI

| Parámetro | Tipo | Descripción |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `modalities` | array | `["text", "audio"]` para multimodalidad |
| `audio` | object | Configuración de salida de audio (voz, formato) |
| `prediction` | object | Salida predictiva para acelerar la generación |
| `metadata` | object | Pares clave-valor para seguimiento |
| `store` | boolean | Almacenar para recuperación posterior |

### Opciones específicas del proveedor

```json
{
  "anthropic_options": {
    "thinking": {
      "type": "enabled",
      "budget_tokens": 10000
    },
    "prompt_caching": true
  },
  "google_options": {
    "safety_settings": [...],
    "google_search": true,
    "code_execution": true
  }
}
```

## Parámetros de Anthropic Messages

### Parámetros principales

| Parámetro | Tipo | Descripción |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identificador del modelo |
| `messages` | array | Mensajes de conversación |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Salida máxima (hasta 128000) |
| `system` | string/array | Prompt del sistema |
| `stream` | boolean | Habilitar transmisión en streaming |

### Llamadas a herramientas

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get weather",
      "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "location": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": {
    "type": "auto",
    "disable_parallel_tool_use": false
  }
}
```

### Pensamiento extendido (Extended Thinking)

```json
{
  "model": "claude-opus-4-5",
  "thinking": {
    "type": "enabled",
    "budget_tokens": 10000
  }
}
```

## Parámetros de Responses API

### Parámetros principales

| Parámetro | Tipo | Descripción |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identificador del modelo |
| `input` | string/array | Contenido de entrada |
| `instructions` | string | Instrucciones del sistema |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | Número máximo de tokens de salida |
| `previous_response_id` | string | Continuar conversación |

### Parámetros avanzados

| Parámetro | Tipo | Descripción |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `truncation_strategy` | string | `"auto"` o `"disabled"` |
| `include` | array | `["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | Aplicable a modelos de razonamiento |
| `service_tier` | string | Nivel de prioridad |

### Formatos de herramientas

Soporta ambos formatos de herramientas, OpenAI y Anthropic:

```json
// Formato OpenAI
{ "type": "function", "name": "fn", "parameters": {...} }

// Formato Anthropic (compatible con Cursor)
{ "name": "fn", "input_schema": {...} }
```

## Parámetros de Gemini API

### Parámetros principales

| Parámetro | Tipo | Descripción |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `contents` | array | Contenido de la conversación |
| `systemInstruction` | object | Instrucciones del sistema |
| `generationConfig` | object | Configuración de generación |

### Herramientas

```json
{
  "tools": [{
    "functionDeclarations": [{
      "name": "search",
      "description": "Search the web",
      "parameters": {...}
    }],
    "codeExecution": {},
    "googleSearch": {}
  }],
  "toolConfig": {
    "functionCallingConfig": {
      "mode": "AUTO"
    }
  }
}
```

### Configuración de seguridad

```json
{
  "safetySettings": [
    {
      "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
      "threshold": "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Parámetros adicionales

| Parámetro | Tipo | Descripción |
|-----------|------|-------------|

| `responseMimeType` | string | `"text/plain"` o `"application/json"` |
| `responseSchema` | object | JSON schema para salida estructurada |

## Streaming

Todos los endpoints soportan transmisión mediante Server-Sent Events (SSE):

```bash
# Chat Completions
curl https://api.lemondata.cc/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [...], "stream": true}'

# Con seguimiento de uso
-d '{"...", "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}}'
```

## Manejo de errores

LemonData devuelve respuestas de error compatibles con OpenAI:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid API key",
    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

Para más detalles, consulte la [Guía de manejo de errores](/guides/error-handling).

## Mejores prácticas

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Usar passthrough para parámetros desconocidos">
    Todos los esquemas utilizan `.passthrough()`: los parámetros desconocidos se reenviarán al proveedor upstream.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Priorizar stream_options para una facturación precisa">
    Habilite `stream_options.include_usage` para obtener conteos de tokens precisos en las respuestas en streaming.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Usar el formato tool_choice adecuado">
    Asegúrese de que coincida con el formato esperado por su SDK. LemonData acepta tanto el formato de OpenAI como el de Anthropic.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

| Formato | Exemplo | Descrição |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| String | `"auto"`, `"none"`, `"required"` | Seleção simples |
| OpenAI Object | `{ "type": "function", "function": { "name": "fn" } }` | Forçar especificação de função |
| Anthropic Object | `{ "type": "tool", "name": "fn", "disable_parallel_tool_use": true }` | Formato nativo Anthropic |

### Parâmetros Avançados

| Parâmetro | Tipo | Descrição |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `stream_options` | object | `{ include_usage: true }` para obter a contagem de tokens |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"` para modelos o1/o3 |
| `service_tier` | string | `"auto"` ou `"default"` |
| `seed` | integer | Saída determinística |
| `logprobs` | boolean | Retornar probabilidades logarítmicas |
| `top_logprobs` | integer | Número das primeiras probabilidades logarítmicas mais altas (0-20) |
| `logit_bias` | object | Mapeamento de viés de token (-100 a 100) |
| `frequency_penalty` | number | Penalidade de repetição (-2 a 2) |
| `presence_penalty` | number | Penalidade de presença (-2 a 2) |
| `stop` | string/array | Sequências de parada |
| `n` | integer | Número de resultados gerados (1-128) |
| `user` | string | Identificador de usuário para rastreamento |

### Recursos Avançados da OpenAI

| Parâmetro | Tipo | Descrição |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `modalities` | array | `["text", "audio"]` para multimodalidade |
| `audio` | object | Configuração de saída de áudio (voz, formato) |
| `prediction` | object | Saída preditiva para acelerar a geração |
| `metadata` | object | Pares chave-valor para rastreamento |
| `store` | boolean | Armazenar para recuperação posterior |

### Opções Específicas do Provedor

```json
{
  "anthropic_options": {
    "thinking": {
      "type": "enabled",
      "budget_tokens": 10000
    },
    "prompt_caching": true
  },
  "google_options": {
    "safety_settings": [...],
    "google_search": true,
    "code_execution": true
  }
}
```

## Parâmetros de Anthropic Messages

### Parâmetros Principais

| Parâmetro | Tipo | Descrição |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identificador do modelo |
| `messages` | array | Mensagens da conversa |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Saída máxima (até 128000) |
| `system` | string/array | Prompt do sistema |
| `stream` | boolean | Habilitar streaming |

### Chamada de Ferramentas (Tool Calling)

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get weather",
      "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "location": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": {
    "type": "auto",
    "disable_parallel_tool_use": false
  }
}
```

### Cadeia de Pensamento Estendida (Extended Thinking)

```json
{
  "model": "claude-opus-4-5",
  "thinking": {
    "type": "enabled",
    "budget_tokens": 10000
  }
}
```

## Parâmetros da API de Responses

### Parâmetros Principais

| Parâmetro | Tipo | Descrição |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identificador do modelo |
| `input` | string/array | Conteúdo de entrada |
| `instructions` | string | Instruções do sistema |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | Número máximo de tokens de saída |
| `previous_response_id` | string | Continuar conversa |

### Parâmetros Avançados

| Parâmetro | Tipo | Descrição |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `truncation_strategy` | string | `"auto"` ou `"disabled"` |
| `include` | array | `["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | Aplicável a modelos de raciocínio |
| `service_tier` | string | Nível de prioridade |

### Formatos de Ferramentas

Suporta ambos os formatos de ferramentas OpenAI e Anthropic:

```json
// Formato OpenAI
{ "type": "function", "name": "fn", "parameters": {...} }

// Formato Anthropic (compatível com Cursor)
{ "name": "fn", "input_schema": {...} }
```

## Parâmetros da API Gemini

### Parâmetros Principais

| Parâmetro | Tipo | Descrição |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `contents` | array | Conteúdo da conversa |
| `systemInstruction` | object | Instrução do sistema |
| `generationConfig` | object | Configuração de geração |

### Ferramentas

```json
{
  "tools": [{
    "functionDeclarations": [{
      "name": "search",
      "description": "Search the web",
      "parameters": {...}
    }],
    "codeExecution": {},
    "googleSearch": {}
  }],
  "toolConfig": {
    "functionCallingConfig": {
      "mode": "AUTO"
    }
  }
}
```

### Configurações de Segurança

```json
{
  "safetySettings": [
    {
      "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
      "threshold": "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Parâmetros Adicionais

| Parâmetro | Tipo | Descrição |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `cachedContent` | string | Referência de conteúdo em cache |
| `responseMimeType` | string | `"text/plain"` ou `"application/json"` |
| `responseSchema` | object | JSON schema para saída estruturada |

## Streaming

Todos os endpoints suportam streaming via Server-Sent Events (SSE):

```bash
# Chat Completions
curl https://api.lemondata.cc/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [...], "stream": true}'

# Com rastreamento de uso
-d '{"...", "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}}'
```

## Tratamento de Erros

O LemonData retorna respostas de erro compatíveis com a OpenAI:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid API key",
    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

Veja detalhes no [Guia de Tratamento de Erros](/guides/error-handling).

## Melhores Práticas

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Use repasse (passthrough) para parâmetros desconhecidos">
    Todos os schemas usam `.passthrough()` — parâmetros desconhecidos serão encaminhados ao provedor upstream.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Priorize o uso de stream_options para faturamento preciso">
    Habilite `stream_options.include_usage` para obter contagens precisas de tokens em respostas de streaming.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Use o formato tool_choice apropriado">
    Corresponda ao formato esperado pelo seu SDK. O LemonData aceita tanto o formato OpenAI quanto o Anthropic.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
translations.ar:
---
title: "توافق IDE و SDK"
description: "مرجع التوافق الكامل لأدوات برمجة الذكاء الاصطناعي و SDKs وإطارات العمل"
---

## نظرة عامة

تم تصميم LemonData API لتحقيق **توافق التوصيل والتشغيل (plug-and-play)** مع جميع أدوات تطوير الذكاء الاصطناعي الرئيسية. يوثق هذا الدليل المعلمات المدعومة والتكاملات التي تم التحقق منها.

<Note>
  يتم التحقق من جميع المعلمات وتمريرها إلى المزودين الأساسيين. سيتم تجاهل المعلمات غير المدعومة لنماذج معينة بصمت لضمان أقصى قدر من التوافق.
</Note>

## تنسيقات API المدعومة

| نقطة النهاية | التنسيق | حالة الاستخدام |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | توافق عام |
| `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | محادثات ذات حالة (Stateful) |
| `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | ميزات Claude الأصلية |
| `/v1beta/models/:model:generateContent` | Google Gemini | ميزات Gemini الأصلية |

## توافق IDE و CLI

### الأدوات التي تم التحقق منها

| الأداة | الحالة | التنسيق | ملاحظات |
|------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Cursor** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | OpenAI | يدعم تنسيق أدوات Anthropic |
| **Claude Code CLI** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | Anthropic | يدعم Extended thinking و tool_choice |
| **Windsurf** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | OpenAI | تنسيق OpenAI القياسي |
| **Aider** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | OpenAI | يدعم جميع النماذج |
| **Continue.dev** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | OpenAI/Anthropic | دعم التنسيق المزدوج |
| **OpenCode** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | OpenAI | دعم مزودين متعددين |
| **Cline/Roo Code** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | OpenAI | عبر تنسيق OpenRouter |
| **GitHub Copilot** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | OpenAI | التنسيق القياسي |
| **Codex CLI** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | OpenAI | OpenAI Responses API |
| **Gemini CLI** | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | Gemini | تنسيق Gemini الأصلي |

### أمثلة التكوين

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Cursor">
    ```
    Base URL: https://api.lemondata.cc/v1
    API Key: sk-your-lemondata-key
    ```
    يستخدم Cursor داخليًا تنسيق أدوات بأسلوب Anthropic. يدعم LemonData كلا التنسيقين التاليين:
    - تنسيق OpenAI: `{ type: "function", function: { name, parameters } }`
    - تنسيق Anthropic: `{ name, input_schema }` (بدون حقل type)
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Claude Code">
    ```bash
    export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.lemondata.cc"
    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="OpenCode">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export LOCAL_ENDPOINT="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Aider">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export OPENAI_API_BASE="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    aider --model gpt-4o
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## توافق SDK

### SDKs التي تم التحقق منها

| SDK | اللغة | الحالة | ملاحظات |
|-----|----------|--------|-------|
| **OpenAI SDK** | Python/JS/Go | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | يدعم جميع المعلمات |
| **Anthropic SDK** | Python/JS | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | يدعم Extended thinking و tools |
| **Vercel AI SDK** | TypeScript | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | يدعم streamText و generateObject |
| **LangChain** | Python/JS | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | يدعم ChatOpenAI و bind_tools |
| **LlamaIndex** | Python | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | متوافق مع OpenAI |
| **Dify** | - | ✅ مدعوم بالكامل | تنسيق OpenAI |

## معلمات Chat Completions

### المعلمات الأساسية

| المعلمة | النوع | الوصف |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | معرف النموذج (مطلوب) |
| `messages` | array | رسائل المحادثة (مطلوب) |
| `max_tokens` | integer | الحد الأقصى لعدد tokens المخرجة |
| `temperature` | number | درجة حرارة أخذ العينات (0-2) |
| `top_p` | number | أخذ العينات النووي (0-1) |
| `stream` | boolean | تمكين البث (streaming) |

### استدعاء الأدوات

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "Get weather for a location",
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "location": { "type": "string" }
          }
        },
        "strict": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": "auto",
  "parallel_tool_calls": true
}
```

### خيارات اختيار الأدوات

| التنسيق | مثال | الوصف |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| String | `"auto"`, `"none"`, `"required"` | اختيار بسيط |
| OpenAI Object | `{ "type": "function", "function": { "name": "fn" } }` | تحديد وظيفة معينة إجباريًا |
| Anthropic Object | `{ "type": "tool", "name": "fn", "disable_parallel_tool_use": true }` | تنسيق Anthropic الأصلي |

### المعلمات المتقدمة

| المعلمة | النوع | الوصف |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `stream_options` | object | يستخدم `{ include_usage: true }` للحصول على عدد tokens |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | متاح لنماذج o1/o3 بقيم `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"` |
| `service_tier` | string | `"auto"` أو `"default"` |
| `seed` | integer | مخرجات محددة (Deterministic) |
| `logprobs` | boolean | إرجاع احتمالات السجل (log probabilities) |
| `top_logprobs` | integer | عدد أعلى احتمالات السجل (0-20) |
| `logit_bias` | object | خريطة انحياز الـ Token (-100 إلى 100) |
| `frequency_penalty` | number | عقوبة التكرار (-2 إلى 2) |
| `presence_penalty` | number | عقوبة الحضور (-2 إلى 2) |
| `stop` | string/array | تسلسلات التوقف |
| `n` | integer | عدد النتائج المولدة (1-128) |
| `user` | string | معرف المستخدم للتتبع |

### ميزات OpenAI المتقدمة

| المعلمة | النوع | الوصف |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `modalities` | array | `["text", "audio"]` للوسائط المتعددة |
| `audio` | object | تكوين مخرجات الصوت (الصوت، التنسيق) |
| `prediction` | object | مخرجات متوقعة لتسريع التوليد |
| `metadata` | object | أزواج مفتاح-قيمة للتتبع |
| `store` | boolean | التخزين للاسترجاع لاحقًا |

### خيارات خاصة بالمزود

```json
{
  "anthropic_options": {
    "thinking": {
      "type": "enabled",
      "budget_tokens": 10000
    },
    "prompt_caching": true
  },
  "google_options": {
    "safety_settings": [...],
    "google_search": true,
    "code_execution": true
  }
}
```

## معلمات Anthropic Messages

### المعلمات الأساسية

| المعلمة | النوع | الوصف |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | معرف النموذج |
| `messages` | array | رسائل المحادثة |
| `max_tokens` | integer | الحد الأقصى للمخرجات (حتى 128000) |
| `system` | string/array | تعليمات النظام |
| `stream` | boolean | تمكين البث (streaming) |

### استدعاء الأدوات

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get weather",
      "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "location": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": {
    "type": "auto",
    "disable_parallel_tool_use": false
  }
}
```

### التفكير الممتد (Extended Thinking)

```json
{
  "model": "claude-opus-4-5",
  "thinking": {
    "type": "enabled",
    "budget_tokens": 10000
  }
}
```

## معلمات Responses API

### المعلمات الأساسية

| المعلمة | النوع | الوصف |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | معرف النموذج |
| `input` | string/array | محتوى الإدخال |
| `instructions` | string | تعليمات النظام |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | الحد الأقصى لعدد tokens المخرجة |
| `previous_response_id` | string | متابعة المحادثة |

### المعلمات المتقدمة

| المعلمة | النوع | الوصف |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `truncation_strategy` | string | `"auto"` أو `"disabled"` |
| `include` | array | `["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | متاح لنماذج الاستدلال (reasoning models) |
| `service_tier` | string | مستوى الأولوية |

### تنسيقات الأدوات

يدعم كلا تنسيقي الأدوات OpenAI و Anthropic:

```json
// تنسيق OpenAI
{ "type": "function", "name": "fn", "parameters": {...} }

// تنسيق Anthropic (متوافق مع Cursor)
{ "name": "fn", "input_schema": {...} }
```

## معلمات Gemini API

### المعلمات الأساسية

| المعلمة | النوع | الوصف |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `contents` | array | محتويات المحادثة |
| `systemInstruction` | object | تعليمات النظام |
| `generationConfig` | object | تكوين التوليد |

### الأدوات

```json
{
  "tools": [{
    "functionDeclarations": [{
      "name": "search",
      "description": "Search the web",
      "parameters": {...}
    }],
    "codeExecution": {},
    "googleSearch": {}
  }],
  "toolConfig": {
    "functionCallingConfig": {
      "mode": "AUTO"
    }
  }
}
```

### إعدادات الأمان

```json
{
  "safetySettings": [
    {
      "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
      "threshold": "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE"
    }
  ]
}
```

### معلمات إضافية

| المعلمة | النوع | الوصف |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `cachedContent` | string | مرجع للمحتوى المخزن مؤقتًا |
| `responseMimeType` | string | `"text/plain"` أو `"application/json"` |
| `responseSchema` | object | JSON schema للمخرجات المهيكلة |

## البث (Streaming)

تدعم جميع نقاط النهاية بث أحداث المرسلة من الخادم (SSE):

```bash
# Chat Completions
curl https://api.lemondata.cc/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [...], "stream": true}'

# مع تتبع الاستخدام
-d '{"...", "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}}'
```

## معالجة الأخطاء

يعيد LemonData استجابات أخطاء متوافقة مع OpenAI:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid API key",
    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

لمزيد من التفاصيل، راجع [دليل معالجة الأخطاء](/guides/error-handling).

## أفضل الممارسات

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="استخدام التمرير (Passthrough) للمعلمات غير المعروفة">
    تستخدم جميع المخططات (schemas) خاصية `.passthrough()` — سيتم توجيه المعلمات غير المعروفة إلى المزود الأساسي.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="إعطاء الأولوية لـ stream_options لتحقيق فوترة دقيقة">
    قم بتمكين `stream_options.include_usage` للحصول على عدد دقيق للـ tokens في استجابات البث.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="استخدام تنسيق tool_choice المناسب">
    يرجى مطابقة التنسيق المتوقع من SDK الخاص بك. يقبل LemonData كلا التنسيقين OpenAI و Anthropic.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
translations.vi:
---
title: "Tương thích IDE và SDK"
description: "Tài liệu tham khảo đầy đủ về khả năng tương thích cho các công cụ lập trình AI, SDK và framework"
---

## Tổng quan

LemonData API được thiết kế để đạt được **khả năng tương thích cắm-là-chạy (plug-and-play)** với tất cả các công cụ phát triển AI phổ biến. Hướng dẫn này ghi lại các tham số được hỗ trợ và các tích hợp đã được xác minh.

<Note>
  Tất cả các tham số đều được xác minh và chuyển tiếp đến các nhà cung cấp thượng nguồn. Các tham số không được hỗ trợ bởi một model cụ thể sẽ bị bỏ qua một cách âm thầm để đảm bảo khả năng tương thích tối đa.
</Note>

## Các định dạng API được hỗ trợ

| Endpoint | Định dạng | Trường hợp sử dụng |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | Khả năng tương thích chung |
| `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | Hội thoại có trạng thái |
| `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | Tính năng gốc của Claude |
| `/v1beta/models/:model:generateContent` | Google Gemini | Tính năng gốc của Gemini |

## Tương thích IDE và CLI

### Các công cụ đã xác minh

| Công cụ | Trạng thái | Định dạng | Ghi chú |
|------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Cursor** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | OpenAI | Hỗ trợ định dạng tool của Anthropic |
| **Claude Code CLI** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | Anthropic | Hỗ trợ Extended thinking, tool_choice |
| **Windsurf** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | OpenAI | Định dạng OpenAI tiêu chuẩn |
| **Aider** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | OpenAI | Hỗ trợ tất cả model |
| **Continue.dev** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | OpenAI/Anthropic | Hỗ trợ định dạng kép |
| **OpenCode** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | OpenAI | Hỗ trợ đa nhà cung cấp |
| **Cline/Roo Code** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | OpenAI | Thông qua định dạng OpenRouter |
| **GitHub Copilot** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | OpenAI | Định dạng tiêu chuẩn |
| **Codex CLI** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | OpenAI | OpenAI Responses API |
| **Gemini CLI** | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | Gemini | Định dạng Gemini gốc |

### Ví dụ cấu hình

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Cursor">
    ```
    Base URL: https://api.lemondata.cc/v1
    API Key: sk-your-lemondata-key
    ```
    Cursor sử dụng định dạng tool theo phong cách Anthropic bên trong. LemonData hỗ trợ cả hai định dạng sau:
    - Định dạng OpenAI: `{ type: "function", function: { name, parameters } }`
    - Định dạng Anthropic: `{ name, input_schema }` (không có trường type)
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Claude Code">
    ```bash
    export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.lemondata.cc"
    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="OpenCode">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export LOCAL_ENDPOINT="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Aider">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export OPENAI_API_BASE="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    aider --model gpt-4o
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Tương thích SDK

### Các SDK đã xác minh

| SDK | Ngôn ngữ | Trạng thái | Ghi chú |
|-----|----------|--------|-------|
| **OpenAI SDK** | Python/JS/Go | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | Hỗ trợ tất cả tham số |
| **Anthropic SDK** | Python/JS | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | Hỗ trợ Extended thinking, tools |
| **Vercel AI SDK** | TypeScript | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | Hỗ trợ streamText, generateObject |
| **LangChain** | Python/JS | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | Hỗ trợ ChatOpenAI, bind_tools |
| **LlamaIndex** | Python | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | Tương thích OpenAI |
| **Dify** | - | ✅ Hỗ trợ đầy đủ | Định dạng OpenAI |

## Tham số Chat Completions

### Tham số cốt lõi

| Tham số | Kiểu | Mô tả |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Mã định danh model (bắt buộc) |
| `messages` | array | Tin nhắn hội thoại (bắt buộc) |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Số lượng token đầu ra tối đa |
| `temperature` | number | Nhiệt độ lấy mẫu (0-2) |
| `top_p` | number | Lấy mẫu hạt nhân (0-1) |
| `stream` | boolean | Kích hoạt truyền phát (streaming) |

### Gọi công cụ (Tool calling)

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "Get weather for a location",
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "location": { "type": "string" }
          }
        },
        "strict": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": "auto",
  "parallel_tool_calls": true
}
```

### Tùy chọn chọn công cụ

| Định dạng | Ví dụ | Mô tả |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| String | `"auto"`, `"none"`, `"required"` | Lựa chọn đơn giản |
| OpenAI Object | `{ "type": "function", "function": { "name": "fn" } }` | Chỉ định hàm bắt buộc |
| Anthropic Object | `{ "type": "tool", "name": "fn", "disable_parallel_tool_use": true }` | Định dạng gốc của Anthropic |

### Tham số nâng cao

| Tham số | Kiểu | Mô tả |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `stream_options` | object | Dùng để lấy số lượng token `{ include_usage: true }` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | Áp dụng cho các model o1/o3: `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"` |
| `service_tier` | string | `"auto"` hoặc `"default"` |
| `seed` | integer | Đầu ra xác định |
| `logprobs` | boolean | Trả về xác suất log (log probabilities) |
| `top_logprobs` | integer | Số lượng các xác suất log cao nhất (0-20) |
| `logit_bias` | object | Ánh xạ độ lệch (bias) token (-100 đến 100) |
| `frequency_penalty` | number | Phạt lặp lại (-2 đến 2) |
| `presence_penalty` | number | Phạt sự hiện diện (-2 đến 2) |
| `stop` | string/array | Chuỗi dừng |
| `n` | integer | Số lượng kết quả tạo ra (1-128) |
| `user` | string | Mã định danh người dùng để theo dõi |

### Tính năng nâng cao của OpenAI

| Tham số | Kiểu | Mô tả |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `modalities` | array | Dùng cho đa phương thức `["text", "audio"]` |
| `audio` | object | Cấu hình đầu ra âm thanh (giọng nói, định dạng) |
| `prediction` | object | Đầu ra dự đoán để tăng tốc tạo nội dung |
| `metadata` | object | Các cặp khóa-giá trị để theo dõi |
| `store` | boolean | Lưu trữ để truy xuất sau này |

### Tùy chọn dành riêng cho nhà cung cấp

```json
{
  "anthropic_options": {
    "thinking": {
      "type": "enabled",
      "budget_tokens": 10000
    },
    "prompt_caching": true
  },
  "google_options": {
    "safety_settings": [...],
    "google_search": true,
    "code_execution": true
  }
}
```

## Tham số Anthropic Messages

### Tham số cốt lõi

| Tham số | Kiểu | Mô tả |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Mã định danh model |
| `messages` | array | Tin nhắn hội thoại |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Đầu ra tối đa (lên đến 128000) |
| `system` | string/array | Lời nhắc hệ thống (system prompt) |
| `stream` | boolean | Kích hoạt truyền phát (streaming) |

### Gọi công cụ (Tool calling)

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get weather",
      "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "location": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": {
    "type": "auto",
    "disable_parallel_tool_use": false
  }
}
```

### Mở rộng chuỗi suy nghĩ (Extended Thinking)

```json
{
  "model": "claude-opus-4-5",
  "thinking": {
    "type": "enabled",
    "budget_tokens": 10000
  }
}
```

## Tham số Responses API

### Tham số cốt lõi

| Tham số | Kiểu | Mô tả |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Mã định danh model |
| `input` | string/array | Nội dung đầu vào |
| `instructions` | string | Chỉ thị hệ thống |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | Số lượng token đầu ra tối đa |
| `previous_response_id` | string | Tiếp tục hội thoại |

### Tham số nâng cao

| Tham số | Kiểu | Mô tả |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `truncation_strategy` | string | `"auto"` hoặc `"disabled"` |
| `include` | array | `["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | Áp dụng cho các model suy luận |
| `service_tier` | string | Cấp độ ưu tiên |

### Định dạng công cụ

Hỗ trợ cả hai định dạng công cụ OpenAI và Anthropic:

```json
// Định dạng OpenAI
{ "type": "function", "name": "fn", "parameters": {...} }

// Định dạng Anthropic (tương thích Cursor)
{ "name": "fn", "input_schema": {...} }
```

## Tham số Gemini API

### Tham số cốt lõi

| Tham số | Kiểu | Mô tả |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `contents` | array | Nội dung hội thoại |
| `systemInstruction` | object | Lời nhắc hệ thống |
| `generationConfig` | object | Cấu hình tạo nội dung |

### Công cụ

```json
{
  "tools": [{
    "functionDeclarations": [{
      "name": "search",
      "description": "Search the web",
      "parameters": {...}
    }],
    "codeExecution": {},
    "googleSearch": {}
  }],
  "toolConfig": {
    "functionCallingConfig": {
      "mode": "AUTO"
    }
  }
}
```

### Cài đặt an toàn

```json
{
  "safetySettings": [
    {
      "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
      "threshold": "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Tham số bổ sung

| Tham số | Kiểu | Mô tả |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `cachedContent` | string | Tham chiếu nội dung được lưu vào bộ nhớ đệm |
| `responseMimeType` | string | `"text/plain"` hoặc `"application/json"` |
| `responseSchema` | object | JSON schema cho đầu ra có cấu trúc |

## Truyền phát (Streaming)

Tất cả các endpoint đều hỗ trợ truyền phát Sự kiện do máy chủ gửi (SSE):

```bash
# Chat Completions
curl https://api.lemondata.cc/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [...], "stream": true}'

# Với theo dõi mức sử dụng
-d '{"...", "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}}'
```

## Xử lý lỗi

LemonData trả về phản hồi lỗi tương thích với OpenAI:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid API key",
    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

Xem chi tiết tại [Hướng dẫn xử lý lỗi](/guides/error-handling).

## Thực hành tốt nhất

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Sử dụng chuyển tiếp cho các tham số không xác định">
    Tất cả các schema đều sử dụng `.passthrough()` — các tham số không xác định sẽ được chuyển tiếp đến nhà cung cấp thượng nguồn.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Ưu tiên sử dụng stream_options để tính phí chính xác">
    Kích hoạt `stream_options.include_usage` để nhận số lượng token chính xác trong phản hồi truyền phát.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Sử dụng định dạng tool_choice phù hợp">
    Vui lòng khớp với định dạng mà SDK của bạn mong đợi. LemonData chấp nhận cả định dạng OpenAI và Anthropic.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

title: "Kompatibilitas IDE dan SDK"
description: "Referensi kompatibilitas lengkap untuk alat pemrograman AI, SDK, dan framework"
---

## Ikhtisar

LemonData API dirancang untuk mencapai **kompatibilitas plug-and-play** dengan semua alat pengembangan AI utama. Panduan ini mendokumentasikan parameter yang didukung dan integrasi yang telah diverifikasi.

<Note>
  Semua parameter diverifikasi dan diteruskan ke penyedia upstream. Parameter yang tidak didukung oleh model tertentu akan diabaikan secara diam-diam untuk memastikan kompatibilitas maksimal.
</Note>

## Format API yang Didukung

| Endpoint | Format | Skenario Penggunaan |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | Kompatibilitas umum |
| `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | Percakapan stateful |
| `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | Fitur asli Claude |
| `/v1beta/models/:model:generateContent` | Google Gemini | Fitur asli Gemini |

## Kompatibilitas IDE dan CLI

### Alat yang Terverifikasi

| Alat | Status | Format | Catatan |
|------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Cursor** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | OpenAI | Mendukung format tool Anthropic |
| **Claude Code CLI** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | Anthropic | Mendukung Extended thinking, tool_choice |
| **Windsurf** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | OpenAI | Format OpenAI standar |
| **Aider** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | OpenAI | Mendukung semua model |
| **Continue.dev** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | OpenAI/Anthropic | Dukungan format ganda |
| **OpenCode** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | OpenAI | Dukungan multi-provider |
| **Cline/Roo Code** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | OpenAI | Melalui format OpenRouter |
| **GitHub Copilot** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | OpenAI | Format standar |
| **Codex CLI** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | OpenAI | OpenAI Responses API |
| **Gemini CLI** | ✅ Dukungan penuh | Gemini | Format Gemini asli |

### Contoh Konfigurasi

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Cursor">
    ```
    Base URL: https://api.lemondata.cc/v1
    API Key: sk-your-lemondata-key
    ```
    Cursor secara internal menggunakan format tool gaya Anthropic. LemonData mendukung kedua format berikut:
    - Format OpenAI: `{ type: "function", function: { name, parameters } }`
    - Format Anthropic: `{ name, input_schema }` (tanpa field type)
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Claude Code">
    ```bash
    export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.lemondata.cc"
    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="OpenCode">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export LOCAL_ENDPOINT="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Aider">
    ```bash
    export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    export OPENAI_API_BASE="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
    aider --model gpt-4o
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Kompatibilitas SDK

### SDK yang Terverifikasi

| SDK | Bahasa | Status | Catatan |
|-----|----------|--------|-------|
| **OpenAI SDK** | Python/JS/Go | ✅ Dukungan penuh | Mendukung semua parameter |
| **Anthropic SDK** | Python/JS | ✅ Dukungan penuh | Mendukung Extended thinking, tools |
| **Vercel AI SDK** | TypeScript | ✅ Dukungan penuh | Mendukung streamText, generateObject |
| **LangChain** | Python/JS | ✅ Dukungan penuh | Mendukung ChatOpenAI, bind_tools |
| **LlamaIndex** | Python | ✅ Dukungan penuh | Kompatibel dengan OpenAI |
| **Dify** | - | ✅ Dukungan penuh | Format OpenAI |

## Parameter Chat Completions

### Parameter Inti

| Parameter | Tipe | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identifier model (wajib) |
| `messages` | array | Pesan percakapan (wajib) |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Jumlah token output maksimum |
| `temperature` | number | Suhu sampling (0-2) |
| `top_p` | number | Nucleus sampling (0-1) |
| `stream` | boolean | Aktifkan streaming |

### Pemanggilan Tool

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "Get weather for a location",
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "location": { "type": "string" }
          }
        },
        "strict": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": "auto",
  "parallel_tool_calls": true
}
```

### Opsi Pemilihan Tool

| Format | Contoh | Deskripsi |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| String | `"auto"`, `"none"`, `"required"` | Pilihan sederhana |
| OpenAI Object | `{ "type": "function", "function": { "name": "fn" } }` | Menentukan fungsi secara paksa |
| Anthropic Object | `{ "type": "tool", "name": "fn", "disable_parallel_tool_use": true }` | Format asli Anthropic |

### Parameter Lanjutan

| Parameter | Tipe | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `stream_options` | object | `{ include_usage: true }` untuk mendapatkan jumlah token |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"` berlaku untuk model o1/o3 |
| `service_tier` | string | `"auto"` atau `"default"` |
| `seed` | integer | Output deterministik |
| `logprobs` | boolean | Mengembalikan log probabilities |
| `top_logprobs` | integer | Jumlah log probabilities tertinggi (0-20) |
| `logit_bias` | object | Pemetaan bias token (-100 hingga 100) |
| `frequency_penalty` | number | Penalti pengulangan (-2 hingga 2) |
| `presence_penalty` | number | Penalti kehadiran (-2 hingga 2) |
| `stop` | string/array | Urutan berhenti |
| `n` | integer | Jumlah hasil yang dihasilkan (1-128) |
| `user` | string | Identifier pengguna untuk pelacakan |

### Fitur Lanjutan OpenAI

| Parameter | Tipe | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `modalities` | array | `["text", "audio"]` untuk multimodal |
| `audio` | object | Konfigurasi output audio (suara, format) |
| `prediction` | object | Output prediksi untuk mempercepat pembuatan |
| `metadata` | object | Pasangan key-value untuk pelacakan |
| `store` | boolean | Simpan untuk pengambilan di kemudian hari |

### Opsi Spesifik Penyedia

```json
{
  "anthropic_options": {
    "thinking": {
      "type": "enabled",
      "budget_tokens": 10000
    },
    "prompt_caching": true
  },
  "google_options": {
    "safety_settings": [...],
    "google_search": true,
    "code_execution": true
  }
}
```

## Parameter Anthropic Messages

### Parameter Inti

| Parameter | Tipe | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identifier model |
| `messages` | array | Pesan percakapan |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Output maksimum (hingga 128000) |
| `system` | string/array | Prompt sistem |
| `stream` | boolean | Aktifkan streaming |

### Pemanggilan Tool

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get weather",
      "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "location": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": {
    "type": "auto",
    "disable_parallel_tool_use": false
  }
}
```

### Perluasan Rantai Pemikiran (Extended Thinking)

```json
{
  "model": "claude-opus-4-5",
  "thinking": {
    "type": "enabled",
    "budget_tokens": 10000
  }
}
```

## Parameter Responses API

### Parameter Inti

| Parameter | Tipe | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Identifier model |
| `input` | string/array | Konten input |
| `instructions` | string | Instruksi sistem |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | Jumlah token output maksimum |
| `previous_response_id` | string | Lanjutkan percakapan |

### Parameter Lanjutan

| Parameter | Tipe | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `truncation_strategy` | string | `"auto"` atau `"disabled"` |
| `include` | array | `["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | Berlaku untuk model penalaran |
| `service_tier` | string | Tingkat prioritas |

### Format Tool

Mendukung format tool OpenAI dan Anthropic:

```json
// Format OpenAI
{ "type": "function", "name": "fn", "parameters": {...} }

// Format Anthropic (Kompatibel dengan Cursor)
{ "name": "fn", "input_schema": {...} }
```

## Parameter Gemini API

### Parameter Inti

| Parameter | Tipe | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `contents` | array | Konten percakapan |
| `systemInstruction` | object | Prompt sistem |
| `generationConfig` | object | Konfigurasi pembuatan |

### Tool

```json
{
  "tools": [{
    "functionDeclarations": [{
      "name": "search",
      "description": "Search the web",
      "parameters": {...}
    }],
    "codeExecution": {},
    "googleSearch": {}
  }],
  "toolConfig": {
    "functionCallingConfig": {
      "mode": "AUTO"
    }
  }
}
```

### Pengaturan Keamanan

```json
{
  "safetySettings": [
    {
      "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
      "threshold": "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Parameter Tambahan

| Parameter | Tipe | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `cachedContent` | string | Referensi konten cache |
| `responseMimeType` | string | `"text/plain"` atau `"application/json"` |
| `responseSchema` | object | JSON schema untuk output terstruktur |

## Streaming

Semua endpoint mendukung streaming Server-Sent Events (SSE):

```bash
# Chat Completions
curl https://api.lemondata.cc/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [...], "stream": true}'

# Dengan pelacakan penggunaan
-d '{"...", "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}}'
```

## Penanganan Kesalahan

LemonData mengembalikan respons kesalahan yang kompatibel dengan OpenAI:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid API key",
    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

Lihat [Panduan Penanganan Kesalahan](/guides/error-handling) untuk detailnya.

## Praktik Terbaik

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Gunakan passthrough untuk parameter yang tidak dikenal">
    Semua schema menggunakan `.passthrough()` — parameter yang tidak dikenal akan diteruskan ke penyedia upstream.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Prioritaskan penggunaan stream_options untuk penagihan yang akurat">
    Aktifkan `stream_options.include_usage` untuk mendapatkan jumlah token yang akurat dalam respons streaming.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Gunakan format tool_choice yang sesuai">
    Harap sesuaikan dengan format yang diharapkan oleh SDK Anda. LemonData menerima format OpenAI dan Anthropic.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Genel Bakış

LemonData API, tüm ana akım AI geliştirme araçlarıyla **tak-çalıştır uyumluluk** sağlamak üzere tasarlanmıştır. Bu kılavuz, desteklenen parametreleri ve doğrulanmış entegrasyonları belgelemektedir.

<Note>
  Tüm parametreler doğrulanır ve yukarı akış sağlayıcılara iletilir. Belirli bir model tarafından desteklenmeyen parametreler, maksimum uyumluluğu sağlamak için sessizce yoksayılır.
</Note>

## Desteklenen API Formatları

| Uç Nokta | Format | Kullanım Durumu |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | Genel uyumluluk |
| `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | Durumlu konuşmalar |
| `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | Claude yerel özellikleri |
| `/v1beta/models/:model:generateContent` | Google Gemini | Gemini yerel özellikleri |

## Chat Completions Parametreleri

### Çekirdek Parametreler

| Parametre | Tür | Açıklama |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Model tanımlayıcı (zorunlu) |
| `messages` | array | Konuşma mesajları (zorunlu) |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Maksimum çıktı token sayısı |
| `temperature` | number | Örnekleme sıcaklığı (0-2) |
| `top_p` | number | Çekirdek örnekleme (0-1) |
| `stream` | boolean | Akış iletimini etkinleştir |

### Araç Çağırma

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "Get weather for a location",
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "location": { "type": "string" }
          }
        },
        "strict": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": "auto",
  "parallel_tool_calls": true
}
```

### Araç Seçimi Seçenekleri

| Format | Örnek | Açıklama |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| String | `"auto"`, `"none"`, `"required"` | Basit seçim |
| OpenAI Object | `{ "type": "function", "function": { "name": "fn" } }` | Fonksiyonu zorunlu kıl |
| Anthropic Object | `{ "type": "tool", "name": "fn", "disable_parallel_tool_use": true }` | Anthropic yerel formatı |

### Gelişmiş Parametreler

| Parametre | Tür | Açıklama |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `stream_options` | object | Token sayımı almak için `{ include_usage: true }` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | o1/o3 modelleri için geçerli `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"` |
| `service_tier` | string | `"auto"` veya `"default"` |
| `seed` | integer | Deterministik çıktı |
| `logprobs` | boolean | Log olasılıklarını döndür |
| `top_logprobs` | integer | En yüksek log olasılıklarının sayısı (0-20) |
| `logit_bias` | object | Token yanlılık eşlemesi (-100 ile 100 arası) |
| `frequency_penalty` | number | Tekrar cezası (-2 ile 2 arası) |
| `presence_penalty` | number | Varlık cezası (-2 ile 2 arası) |
| `stop` | string/array | Durdurma dizileri |
| `n` | integer | Üretilen sonuç sayısı (1-128) |
| `user` | string | İzleme için kullanıcı tanımlayıcı |

### OpenAI Gelişmiş Özellikleri

| Parametre | Tür | Açıklama |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `modalities` | array | Çok modlu kullanım için `["text", "audio"]` |
| `audio` | object | Ses çıkış yapılandırması (ses tonu, format) |
| `prediction` | object | Üretimi hızlandırmak için tahmini çıktı |
| `metadata` | object | İzleme için anahtar-değer çiftleri |
| `store` | boolean | Daha sonra geri çağırmak için sakla |

### Sağlayıcıya Özel Seçenekler

```json
{
  "anthropic_options": {
    "thinking": {
      "type": "enabled",
      "budget_tokens": 10000
    },
    "prompt_caching": true
  },
  "google_options": {
    "safety_settings": [...],
    "google_search": true,
    "code_execution": true
  }
}
```

## Anthropic Messages Parametreleri

### Çekirdek Parametreler

| Parametre | Tür | Açıklama |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Model tanımlayıcı |
| `messages` | array | Konuşma mesajları |
| `max_tokens` | integer | Maksimum çıktı (128000'e kadar) |
| `system` | string/array | Sistem istemi (prompt) |
| `stream` | boolean | Akış iletimini etkinleştir |

### Araç Çağırma

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_weather",
      "description": "Get weather",
      "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "location": { "type": "string" }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": {
    "type": "auto",
    "disable_parallel_tool_use": false
  }
}
```

### Genişletilmiş Düşünme (Extended Thinking)

```json
{
  "model": "claude-opus-4-5",
  "thinking": {
    "type": "enabled",
    "budget_tokens": 10000
  }
}
```

## Responses API Parametreleri

### Çekirdek Parametreler

| Parametre | Tür | Açıklama |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | string | Model tanımlayıcı |
| `input` | string/array | Giriş içeriği |
| `instructions` | string | Sistem talimatları |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | Maksimum çıktı token sayısı |
| `previous_response_id` | string | Konuşmaya devam et |

### Gelişmiş Parametreler

| Parametre | Tür | Açıklama |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `truncation_strategy` | string | `"auto"` veya `"disabled"` |
| `include` | array | `["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` |
| `reasoning_effort` | string | Akıl yürütme modelleri için geçerlidir |
| `service_tier` | string | Öncelik katmanı |

### Araç Formatları

Hem OpenAI hem de Anthropic araç formatlarını destekler:

```json
// OpenAI formatı
{ "type": "function", "name": "fn", "parameters": {...} }

// Anthropic formatı (Cursor uyumlu)
{ "name": "fn", "input_schema": {...} }
```

## Gemini API Parametreleri

### Çekirdek Parametreler

| Parametre | Tür | Açıklama |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `contents` | array | Konuşma içeriği |
| `systemInstruction` | object | Sistem istemi |
| `generationConfig` | object | Üretim yapılandırması |

### Araçlar

```json
{
  "tools": [{
    "functionDeclarations": [{
      "name": "search",
      "description": "Search the web",
      "parameters": {...}
    }],
    "codeExecution": {},
    "googleSearch": {}
  }],
  "toolConfig": {
    "functionCallingConfig": {
      "mode": "AUTO"
    }
  }
}
```

### Güvenlik Ayarları

```json
{
  "safetySettings": [
    {
      "category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT",
      "threshold": "BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Ek Parametreler

| Parametre | Tür | Açıklama |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `cachedContent` | string | Önbelleğe alınmış içerik referansı |
| `responseMimeType` | string | `"text/plain"` veya `"application/json"` |
| `responseSchema` | object | Yapılandırılmış çıktı için JSON schema |

## Akış (Streaming)

Tüm uç noktalar Sunucu Tarafından Gönderilen Olaylar (SSE) akışını destekler:

```bash
# Chat Completions
curl https://api.lemondata.cc/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [...], "stream": true}'

# Kullanım takibi ile
-d '{"...", "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}}'
```

## Hata Yönetimi

LemonData, OpenAI uyumlu hata yanıtları döndürür:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid API key",
    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

Daha fazla bilgi için bkz. [Hata Yönetimi Kılavuzu](/guides/error-handling).

## En İyi Uygulamalar

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Bilinmeyen parametreler için geçiş (passthrough) kullanın">
    Tüm şemalar `.passthrough()` kullanır — bilinmeyen parametreler yukarı akış sağlayıcısına iletilir.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Hassas faturalandırma için stream_options kullanımına öncelik verin">
    Akış yanıtlarında doğru token sayısını almak için `stream_options.include_usage` özelliğini etkinleştirin.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Uygun tool_choice formatını kullanın">
    Lütfen SDK'nızın beklediği formatla eşleştirin. LemonData hem OpenAI hem de Anthropic formatlarını kabul eder.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## 概览

LemonData API 旨在与所有主流 AI 开发工具实现**即插即用式兼容**。本指南记录了支持的参数和经过验证的集成。

<Note>
  所有参数均经过验证并透传至上游供应商。针对特定模型不支持的参数将被静默忽略，以确保最大程度的兼容性。
</Note>

## 支持的 API 格式

| `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | 通用兼容性 |
| `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | 有状态对话 |
| `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | Claude 原生功能 |
| `/v1beta/models/:model:generateContent` | Google Gemini | Gemini 原生功能 |

| **OpenCode** | ✅ 完全支持 | OpenAI | 多供应商支持 |

## Chat Completions 参数

| 参数 | 类型 | 描述 |

```json
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",

          "properties": {
            "location": { "type": "string" }
          }
        },
        "strict": true
      }
    }

  "parallel_tool_calls": true
```

### 工具选择选项

| 格式 | 示例 | 描述 |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| String | `"auto"`, `"none"`, `"required"` | 简单选择 |

## 流式传输

所有端点均支持服务器发送事件 (SSE) 流式传输：

```bash
# Chat Completions
curl https://api.lemondata.cc/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [...], "stream": true}'

# 带用量追踪
-d '{"...", "stream_options": {"include_usage": true}}'
```

## 错误处理

LemonData 返回兼容 OpenAI 的错误响应：

```json
{
  "error": {

    "type": "invalid_api_key",
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

## 最佳实践

<AccordionGroup>

title: "IDE 與 SDK 相容性"
description: "AI 程式設計工具、SDK 和框架的完整相容性參考"

## 概覽

LemonData API 旨在與所有主流 AI 開發工具實現**即插即用式相容**。本指南記錄了支援的參數和經過驗證的整合。

<Note>
  所有參數均經過驗證並透傳至上游提供商。針對特定模型不支援的參數將被靜默忽略，以確保最大程度的相容性。
</Note>

## 支援的 API 格式

| 端點 | 格式 | 使用場景 |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | 通用相容性 |
| `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | 有狀態對話 |
| `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | Claude 原生功能 |
| `/v1beta/models/:model:generateContent` | Google Gemini | Gemini 原生功能 |

## IDE 與 CLI 相容性

### 已驗證工具

| 工具 | 狀態 | 格式 | 備註 |
|------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Cursor** | ✅ 完全支援 | OpenAI | 支援 Anthropic 工具格式 |
| **Claude Code CLI** | ✅ 完全支援 | Anthropic | 支援 Extended thinking, tool_choice |
| **Windsurf** | ✅ 完全支援 | OpenAI | 標準 OpenAI 格式 |
| **Aider** | ✅ 完全支援 | OpenAI | 支援所有模型 |
| **Continue.dev** | ✅ 完全支援 | OpenAI/Anthropic | 雙格式支援 |
| **OpenCode** | ✅ 完全支援 | OpenAI | 多提供商支援 |
| **Cline/Roo Code** | ✅ 完全支援 | OpenAI | 透過 OpenRouter 格式 |
| **GitHub Copilot** | ✅ 完全支援 | OpenAI | 標準格式 |
| **Codex CLI** | ✅ 完全支援 | OpenAI | OpenAI Responses API |
| **Gemini CLI** | ✅ 完全支援 | Gemini | 原生 Gemini 格式 |

### 配置示例

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Cursor">
    ```
    Base URL: https://api.lemondata.cc/v1
    API Key: sk-your-lemondata-key
    ```
    Cursor 內部使用 Anthropic 風格的工具格式。LemonData 同時支援以下兩種格式：
    - OpenAI 格式：`{ type: "function", function: { name, parameters } }`
    - Anthropic 格式：`{ name, input_schema }`（無 type 欄位）
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Claude Code">
    ```bash
    export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.lemondata.cc"
    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-your-lemondata-key"
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="Aider">
