---
title: "✨ API Agent-First"
description: "Indices d'erreur structurés pour permettre aux agents IA de s'auto-corriger dès la première tentative"
---

## Présentation

L'API Agent-First de LemonData enrichit les réponses d'erreur avec des indices structurés que les agents IA peuvent analyser et exploiter immédiatement — sans recherche web, sans consultation de documentation, sans approximation.

Chaque réponse d'erreur inclut des champs optionnels tels que `did_you_mean`, `suggestions`, `hint`, `retryable` et `retry_after` à l'intérieur de l'objet `error` standard. Ces champs sont rétrocompatibles — les clients qui ne les utilisent pas ne voient aucune différence.

## Champs d'indices d'erreur

Tous les champs d'indices sont des extensions optionnelles à l'intérieur de l'objet `error` :

| Champ | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `did_you_mean` | `string` | Nom du modèle correspondant le plus proche |
| `suggestions` | `array` | Modèles recommandés avec métadonnées |
| `alternatives` | `array` | Modèles alternatifs actuellement disponibles |
| `hint` | `string` | Conseils sur l'étape suivante lisibles par l'humain ou l'agent |
| `retryable` | `boolean` | Indique si une nouvelle tentative de la même requête peut réussir |
| `retry_after` | `number` | Secondes à attendre avant de réessayer |
| `balance_usd` | `number` | Solde actuel du compte en USD |
| `estimated_cost_usd` | `number` | Coût estimé de la requête ayant échoué |

## Exemples de codes d'erreur

### model_not_found (400)

Lorsqu'un nom de modèle ne correspond à aucun modèle actif :

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model 'gpt5' not found",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "model",
    "code": "model_not_found",
    "did_you_mean": "gpt-4o",
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o"},
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Did you mean 'gpt-4o'? Use GET /v1/models to list all available models."
  }
}
```

La résolution de `did_you_mean` utilise :
1. Un mappage d'alias statique (à partir des données d'erreur de production)
2. Une correspondance de chaînes normalisées (supprime les traits d'union, insensible à la casse)
3. Une correspondance par distance d'édition (seuil ≤ 3)

### insufficient_balance (402)

Lorsque le solde du compte est trop bas pour le coût estimé :

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200.",
    "type": "insufficient_balance",
    "code": "insufficient_balance",
    "balance_usd": 0.12,
    "estimated_cost_usd": 0.35,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "deepseek-chat"}
    ],
    "hint": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200. Try a cheaper model, or top up at https://lemondata.cc/dashboard/billing."
  }
}
```

`suggestions` contient des modèles moins chers que le coût estimé vers lesquels l'agent peut basculer.

### all_channels_failed (503)

Lorsque tous les canaux amont pour un modèle sont indisponibles :

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model claude-opus-4-6 temporarily unavailable",
    "code": "all_channels_failed",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 30,
    "alternatives": [
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5", "status": "available", "tags": []},
      {"id": "gpt-4o", "status": "available", "tags": []}
    ],
    "hint": "All channels for 'claude-opus-4-6' are temporarily unavailable. Retry in 30s or try an alternative model."
  }
}
```

<Note>
`retryable` est `false` lorsque la raison est `no_channels` (aucun canal configuré pour ce modèle). Il est `true` uniquement pour les échecs transitoires comme les déclenchements de disjoncteur ou l'épuisement des quotas.
</Note>

### rate_limit_exceeded (429)

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Rate limit: 60 rpm exceeded",
    "type": "rate_limit_error",
    "code": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 8,
    "hint": "Rate limited. Retry after 8s. Current limit: 60/min for user role."
  }
}
```

La valeur `retry_after` est calculée à partir du temps de réinitialisation réel de la fenêtre de limite de débit.

### context_length_exceeded (400)

Lorsque l'entrée dépasse la fenêtre de contexte du modèle (erreur en amont, enrichie d'indices) :

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "This model's maximum context length is 128000 tokens...",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "code": "context_length_exceeded",
    "retryable": false,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gemini-2.5-pro"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Reduce your input or switch to a model with a larger context window."
  }
}
```

## En-têtes d'endpoint natif

Lorsque vous appelez `/v1/chat/completions` avec un modèle disposant d'un endpoint natif (Anthropic ou Gemini), la **réponse de succès** inclut des en-têtes d'optimisation :

```
X-LemonData-Hint: This model supports native Anthropic format. Use POST /v1/messages for better performance (no format conversion).
X-LemonData-Native-Endpoint: /v1/messages
```

| Fournisseur du modèle | Endpoint suggéré | Avantage |
|---------------|-------------------|---------|
| Anthropic (Claude) | `/v1/messages` | Pas de conversion de format, réflexion étendue, mise en cache des prompts |
| Google (Gemini) | `/v1beta/gemini` | Pas de conversion de format, ancrage (grounding), paramètres de sécurité |
| OpenAI | — | Chat completions est déjà le format natif |

Ces en-têtes apparaissent sur les réponses en streaming et hors streaming.

## Améliorations de /v1/models

Trois nouveaux champs dans l'extension `lemondata` de chaque objet modèle :

```json
{
  "id": "gpt-4o",
  "lemondata": {
    "category": "chat",
    "pricing_unit": "per_token",
    "cache_pricing": {
      "cache_read_per_1m": "1.25",
      "cache_write_per_1m": "2.50",
      "platform_cache_discount": 0.9
    }
  }
}
```

| Champ | Valeurs | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `category` | `chat`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `tts`, `stt`, `3d`, `embedding`, `rerank` | Type de modèle |
| `pricing_unit` | `per_token`, `per_image`, `per_second`, `per_request` | Comment le modèle est facturé |
| `cache_pricing` | objet ou `null` | Prix du cache de prompt en amont + remise sur le cache sémantique de la plateforme |

### Filtrage par catégorie

```bash
GET /v1/models?category=chat          # Modèles de chat uniquement
GET /v1/models?category=image         # Modèles de génération d'images
GET /v1/models?tag=coding&category=chat  # Modèles de chat optimisés pour le code
```

## llms.txt

Un aperçu de l'API lisible par machine est disponible à l'adresse :

```
GET https://api.lemondata.cc/llms.txt
```

Il comprend :
- Un modèle de premier appel avec un exemple fonctionnel
- Les noms de modèles courants (générés dynamiquement à partir des données d'utilisation)
- Les 12 endpoints API
- Des paramètres de filtrage pour la découverte de modèles
- Des conseils sur la gestion des erreurs

Les agents IA qui lisent `llms.txt` avant leur premier appel API peuvent généralement réussir dès la première tentative.

## Utilisation dans le code de l'agent

### Python (SDK OpenAI)

```python
from openai import OpenAI, BadRequestError

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="sk-your-key",
    base_url="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
)

def smart_chat(messages, model="gpt-4o"):
    try:
        return client.chat.completions.create(
            model=model, messages=messages
        )
    except BadRequestError as e:
        error = e.body.get("error", {}) if isinstance(e.body, dict) else {}
        # Utiliser did_you_mean pour l'auto-correction
        if error.get("code") == "model_not_found" and error.get("did_you_mean"):
            return client.chat.completions.create(
                model=error["did_you_mean"], messages=messages
            )
        raise
```

### JavaScript (SDK OpenAI)

```javascript
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const client = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: 'sk-your-key',
  baseURL: 'https://api.lemondata.cc/v1'
});

async function smartChat(messages, model = 'gpt-4o') {
  try {
    return await client.chat.completions.create({ model, messages });
  } catch (error) {
    const err = error?.error;
    if (err?.code === 'model_not_found' && err?.did_you_mean) {
      return client.chat.completions.create({
        model: err.did_you_mean, messages
      });
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## Principes de conception

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Échouer rapidement, échouer de manière informative" icon="bolt">
    Les erreurs sont renvoyées immédiatement avec toutes les données dont un agent a besoin pour s'auto-corriger.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Pas de routage automatique" icon="route">
    L'API ne substitue jamais silencieusement un modèle différent. C'est l'agent qui décide.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Suggestions basées sur les données" icon="database">
    Toutes les recommandations proviennent de données de production, et non de listes codées en dur.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Rétrocompatible" icon="plug">
    Tous les champs d'indices sont optionnels. Les clients existants ne voient aucune différence.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

## Resumen

La API Agent-First de LemonData enriquece las respuestas de error con pistas estructuradas que los agentes de IA pueden analizar y actuar de inmediato — sin búsquedas en la web, sin consultas de documentación y sin conjeturas.

Cada respuesta de error incluye campos opcionales como `did_you_mean`, `suggestions`, `hint`, `retryable` y `retry_after` dentro del objeto estándar `error`. Estos campos son compatibles con versiones anteriores — los clientes que no los utilizan no verán ninguna diferencia.

## Campos de pistas de error

Todos los campos de pistas son extensiones opcionales dentro del objeto `error`:

| Campo | Tipo | Descripción |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `did_you_mean` | `string` | Nombre del modelo con la coincidencia más cercana |
| `suggestions` | `array` | Modelos recomendados con metadatos |
| `alternatives` | `array` | Modelos alternativos disponibles actualmente |
| `hint` | `string` | Guía del siguiente paso legible por humanos/agentes |
| `retryable` | `boolean` | Si reintentar la misma solicitud puede tener éxito |
| `retry_after` | `number` | Segundos a esperar antes de reintentar |
| `balance_usd` | `number` | Saldo actual de la cuenta en USD |
| `estimated_cost_usd` | `number` | Costo estimado de la solicitud fallida |

## Ejemplos de códigos de error

### model_not_found (400)

Cuando el nombre de un modelo no coincide con ningún modelo activo:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model 'gpt5' not found",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "model",
    "code": "model_not_found",
    "did_you_mean": "gpt-4o",
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o"},
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Did you mean 'gpt-4o'? Use GET /v1/models to list all available models."
  }
}
```

La resolución de `did_you_mean` utiliza:
1. Mapeo de alias estáticos (a partir de datos de errores de producción)
2. Coincidencia de cadenas normalizada (elimina guiones, no distingue entre mayúsculas y minúsculas)
3. Coincidencia por distancia de edición (umbral ≤ 3)

### insufficient_balance (402)

Cuando el saldo de la cuenta es demasiado bajo para el costo estimado:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200.",
    "type": "insufficient_balance",
    "code": "insufficient_balance",
    "balance_usd": 0.12,
    "estimated_cost_usd": 0.35,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "deepseek-chat"}
    ],
    "hint": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200. Try a cheaper model, or top up at https://lemondata.cc/dashboard/billing."
  }
}
```

`suggestions` contiene modelos más baratos que el costo estimado a los que el agente puede cambiar.

### all_channels_failed (503)

Cuando todos los canales ascendentes para un modelo no están disponibles:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model claude-opus-4-6 temporarily unavailable",
    "code": "all_channels_failed",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 30,
    "alternatives": [
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5", "status": "available", "tags": []},
      {"id": "gpt-4o", "status": "available", "tags": []}
    ],
    "hint": "All channels for 'claude-opus-4-6' are temporarily unavailable. Retry in 30s or try an alternative model."
  }
}
```

<Note>
`retryable` es `false` cuando el motivo es `no_channels` (no hay canales configurados para este modelo). Es `true` solo para fallos transitorios como activaciones del circuit breaker o agotamiento de cuota.
</Note>

### rate_limit_exceeded (429)

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Rate limit: 60 rpm exceeded",
    "type": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "code": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 8,
    "hint": "Rate limited. Retry after 8s. Current limit: 60/min for user role."
  }
}
```

El valor de `retry_after` se calcula a partir del tiempo de reinicio de la ventana de límite de tasa real.

<Note>
Los endpoints compatibles con OpenAI utilizan los tipos de error públicos estables de LemonData, como `rate_limit_exceeded`, `upstream_error` y `all_channels_failed`. Los endpoints compatibles con Anthropic y Gemini utilizan sus propias formas de respuesta nativas.
</Note>

### context_length_exceeded (400)

Cuando la entrada excede la ventana de contexto del modelo (error ascendente, enriquecido con pistas):

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "This model's maximum context length is 128000 tokens...",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "code": "context_length_exceeded",
    "retryable": false,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gemini-2.5-pro"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Reduce your input or switch to a model with a larger context window."
  }
}
```

## Encabezados de endpoints nativos

Cuando llamas a `/v1/chat/completions` con un modelo que tiene un endpoint nativo (Anthropic o Gemini), la **respuesta exitosa** incluye encabezados de optimización:

```
X-LemonData-Hint: This model supports native Anthropic format. Use POST /v1/messages for better performance (no format conversion).
X-LemonData-Native-Endpoint: /v1/messages
```

| Proveedor de modelo | Endpoint sugerido | Beneficio |
|---------------|-------------------|---------|
| Anthropic (Claude) | `/v1/messages` | Sin conversión de formato, pensamiento extendido, caché de prompts |
| Google (Gemini) | `/v1beta/gemini` | Sin conversión de formato, grounding, configuraciones de seguridad |
| OpenAI | — | Chat completions ya es el formato nativo |

Estos encabezados aparecen tanto en respuestas de streaming como en las que no son de streaming.

## Mejoras en /v1/models

Tres campos nuevos en la extensión `lemondata` de cada objeto de modelo:

```json
{
  "id": "gpt-4o",
  "lemondata": {
    "category": "chat",
    "pricing_unit": "per_token",
    "cache_pricing": {
      "cache_read_per_1m": "1.25",
      "cache_write_per_1m": "2.50",
      "platform_cache_discount": 0.9
    }
  }
}
```

| Campo | Valores | Descripción |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `category` | `chat`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `tts`, `stt`, `3d`, `embedding`, `rerank` | Tipo de modelo |
| `pricing_unit` | `per_token`, `per_image`, `per_second`, `per_request` | Cómo se factura el modelo |
| `cache_pricing` | objeto o `null` | Precios de caché de prompts ascendentes + descuento de caché semántica de la plataforma |

### Filtrado por categoría

```bash
GET /v1/models?category=chat          # Solo modelos de chat
GET /v1/models?category=image         # Modelos de generación de imágenes
GET /v1/models?tag=coding&category=chat  # Modelos de chat optimizados para codificación
```

## llms.txt

Un resumen de la API legible por máquina está disponible en:

```
GET https://api.lemondata.cc/llms.txt
```

Incluye:
- Plantilla de primera llamada con un ejemplo funcional
- Nombres de modelos comunes (generados dinámicamente a partir de datos de uso)
- Los 12 endpoints de la API
- Parámetros de filtro para el descubrimiento de modelos
- Guía de manejo de errores

Los agentes de IA que leen `llms.txt` antes de su primera llamada a la API suelen tener éxito en el primer intento.

## Uso en código de agentes

### Python (SDK de OpenAI)

```python
from openai import OpenAI, BadRequestError

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="sk-your-key",
    base_url="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
)

def smart_chat(messages, model="gpt-4o"):
    try:
        return client.chat.completions.create(
            model=model, messages=messages
        )
    except BadRequestError as e:
        error = e.body.get("error", {}) if isinstance(e.body, dict) else {}
        # Usar did_you_mean para la autocorrección
        if error.get("code") == "model_not_found" and error.get("did_you_mean"):
            return client.chat.completions.create(
                model=error["did_you_mean"], messages=messages
            )
        raise
```

### JavaScript (SDK de OpenAI)

```javascript
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const client = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: 'sk-your-key',
  baseURL: 'https://api.lemondata.cc/v1'
});

async function smartChat(messages, model = 'gpt-4o') {
  try {
    return await client.chat.completions.create({ model, messages });
  } catch (error) {
    const err = error?.error;
    if (err?.code === 'model_not_found' && err?.did_you_mean) {
      return client.chat.completions.create({
        model: err.did_you_mean, messages
      });
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
```

---
title: "✨ واجهة برمجة تطبيقات (API) مخصصة للوكلاء أولاً"
description: "تلميحات أخطاء منظمة لوكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي للتصحيح الذاتي من المحاولة الأولى"
---

## نظرة عامة

تعمل واجهة برمجة التطبيقات (API) المخصصة للوكلاء أولاً من LemonData على إثراء استجابات الأخطاء بتلميحات منظمة يمكن لوكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي تحليلها والتعامل معها فوراً — دون الحاجة إلى عمليات بحث في الويب، أو مراجعة المستندات، أو التخمين.

تتضمن كل استجابة خطأ حقولاً اختيارية مثل `did_you_mean` و `suggestions` و `hint` و `retryable` و `retry_after` داخل كائن `error` القياسي. هذه الحقول متوافقة مع الإصدارات السابقة — حيث لا تلاحظ التطبيقات التي لا تستخدمها أي فرق.

## حقول تلميحات الأخطاء

جميع حقول التلميحات هي امتدادات اختيارية داخل كائن `error`:

| الحقل | النوع | الوصف |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `did_you_mean` | `string` | أقرب اسم طراز مطابق |
| `suggestions` | `array` | الطرازات الموصى بها مع البيانات الوصفية |
| `alternatives` | `array` | الطرازات البديلة المتاحة حالياً |
| `hint` | `string` | إرشادات للخطوة التالية قابلة للقراءة من قبل البشر/الوكلاء |
| `retryable` | `boolean` | ما إذا كانت إعادة محاولة نفس الطلب قد تنجح |
| `retry_after` | `number` | الثواني التي يجب انتظارها قبل إعادة المحاولة |
| `balance_usd` | `number` | رصيد الحساب الحالي بالدولار الأمريكي |
| `estimated_cost_usd` | `number` | التكلفة التقديرية للطلب الفاشل |

## أمثلة على أكواد الأخطاء

### model_not_found (400)

عندما لا يتطابق اسم الطراز مع أي طراز نشط:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model 'gpt5' not found",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "model",
    "code": "model_not_found",
    "did_you_mean": "gpt-4o",
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o"},
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Did you mean 'gpt-4o'? Use GET /v1/models to list all available models."
  }
}
```

تستخدم معالجة `did_you_mean`:
1. خرائط الأسماء المستعارة الثابتة (من بيانات أخطاء الإنتاج)
2. مطابقة النصوص المعيارية (تجاهل الشرطات وحالة الأحرف)
3. مطابقة مسافة التحرير (Edit distance) (الحد الأقصى ≤ 3)

### insufficient_balance (402)

عندما يكون رصيد الحساب منخفضاً جداً بالنسبة للتكلفة التقديرية:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200.",
    "type": "insufficient_balance",
    "code": "insufficient_balance",
    "balance_usd": 0.12,
    "estimated_cost_usd": 0.35,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "deepseek-chat"}
    ],
    "hint": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200. Try a cheaper model, or top up at https://lemondata.cc/dashboard/billing."
  }
}
```

يحتوي `suggestions` على طرازات أرخص من التكلفة التقديرية يمكن للوكيل الانتقال إليها.

### all_channels_failed (503)

عندما تكون جميع القنوات الموفرة للطراز غير متاحة:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model claude-opus-4-6 temporarily unavailable",
    "code": "all_channels_failed",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 30,
    "alternatives": [
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5", "status": "available", "tags": []},
      {"id": "gpt-4o", "status": "available", "tags": []}
    ],
    "hint": "All channels for 'claude-opus-4-6' are temporarily unavailable. Retry in 30s or try an alternative model."
  }
}
```

<Note>
تكون قيمة `retryable` هي `false` عندما يكون السبب هو `no_channels` (لا توجد قنوات مهيأة لهذا الطراز). وتكون `true` فقط في حالات الفشل المؤقت مثل تعطل القاطع (circuit breaker) أو استنفاد الحصة (quota).
</Note>

### rate_limit_exceeded (429)

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Rate limit: 60 rpm exceeded",
    "type": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "code": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 8,
    "hint": "Rate limited. Retry after 8s. Current limit: 60/min for user role."
  }
}
```

يتم حساب قيمة `retry_after` بناءً على وقت إعادة تعيين نافذة حد المعدل الفعلي.

<Note>
تستخدم نقاط النهاية المتوافقة مع OpenAI أنواع أخطاء عامة مستقرة من LemonData مثل `rate_limit_exceeded` و `upstream_error` و `all_channels_failed`. أما نقاط النهاية المتوافقة مع Anthropic و Gemini فتستخدم أشكال الاستجابة الأصلية الخاصة بها.
</Note>

### context_length_exceeded (400)

عندما يتجاوز الإدخال نافذة السياق الخاصة بالطراز (خطأ من المصدر، معزز بالتلميحات):

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "This model's maximum context length is 128000 tokens...",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "code": "context_length_exceeded",
    "retryable": false,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gemini-2.5-pro"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Reduce your input or switch to a model with a larger context window."
  }
}
```

## رؤوس نقاط النهاية الأصلية (Native Endpoint Headers)

عندما تستدعي `/v1/chat/completions` مع طراز يمتلك نقطة نهاية أصلية (Anthropic أو Gemini)، تتضمن **استجابة النجاح** رؤوس تحسين:

```
X-LemonData-Hint: This model supports native Anthropic format. Use POST /v1/messages for better performance (no format conversion).
X-LemonData-Native-Endpoint: /v1/messages
```

| مزود الطراز | نقطة النهاية المقترحة | الفائدة |
|---------------|-------------------|---------|
| Anthropic (Claude) | `/v1/messages` | لا يوجد تحويل للصيغة، تفكير ممتد، تخزين مؤقت للمطالبات |
| Google (Gemini) | `/v1beta/gemini` | لا يوجد تحويل للصيغة، الربط بالواقع، إعدادات الأمان |
| OpenAI | — | تنسيق Chat completions هو التنسيق الأصلي بالفعل |

تظهر هذه الرؤوس في كل من استجابات البث (streaming) وغير البث.

ثلاثة حقول جديدة في امتداد `lemondata` لكل كائن طراز:

```json

  "lemondata": {
    "category": "chat",
    "pricing_unit": "per_token",

      "platform_cache_discount": 0.9

}
```

| الحقل | القيم | الوصف |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `category` | `chat`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `tts`, `stt`, `3d`, `embedding`, `rerank` | فئة الطراز |
| `pricing_unit` | `per_token`, `per_image`, `per_second`, `per_request` | كيفية فوترة الطراز |
| `cache_pricing` | object أو `null` | أسعار التخزين المؤقت للمطالبات من المصدر + خصم التخزين المؤقت الدلالي للمنصة |

## llms.txt

تتوفر نظرة عامة على واجهة برمجة التطبيقات (API) قابلة للقراءة آلياً على:

```

```

وتتضمن:
- قالب المحاولة الأولى مع مثال يعمل
- أسماء الطرازات الشائعة (يتم إنشاؤها ديناميكياً من بيانات الاستخدام)
- جميع نقاط نهاية API الـ 12
- معلمات التصفية لاكتشاف الطرازات
- إرشادات معالجة الأخطاء

يمكن لوكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي الذين يقرأون `llms.txt` قبل أول استدعاء لـ API النجاح عادةً من المحاولة الأولى.

---
title: "✨ Agent-First API"
description: "Gợi ý lỗi có cấu trúc giúp các AI agent tự sửa lỗi ngay trong lần thử lại đầu tiên"
---

## Tổng quan

Agent-First API của LemonData làm phong phú các phản hồi lỗi bằng các gợi ý có cấu trúc mà AI agent có thể phân tích và xử lý ngay lập tức — không cần tìm kiếm web, không cần tra cứu tài liệu, không cần đoán mò.

Mỗi phản hồi lỗi bao gồm các trường tùy chọn như `did_you_mean`, `suggestions`, `hint`, `retryable`, và `retry_after` bên trong đối tượng `error` tiêu chuẩn. Các trường này có khả năng tương thích ngược — các client không sử dụng chúng sẽ không thấy sự khác biệt nào.

## Các trường gợi ý lỗi

Tất cả các trường gợi ý là các phần mở rộng tùy chọn bên trong đối tượng `error`:

| Trường | Kiểu | Mô tả |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `did_you_mean` | `string` | Tên mô hình khớp nhất |
| `suggestions` | `array` | Các mô hình được đề xuất kèm theo metadata |
| `alternatives` | `array` | Các mô hình thay thế hiện đang có sẵn |
| `hint` | `string` | Hướng dẫn bước tiếp theo có thể đọc được bởi người/agent |
| `retryable` | `boolean` | Liệu việc thử lại cùng một yêu cầu có thể thành công hay không |
| `retry_after` | `number` | Số giây cần chờ trước khi thử lại |
| `balance_usd` | `number` | Số dư tài khoản hiện tại tính bằng USD |
| `estimated_cost_usd` | `number` | Chi phí ước tính của yêu cầu bị lỗi |

## Ví dụ mã lỗi

### model_not_found (400)

Khi tên mô hình không khớp với bất kỳ mô hình nào đang hoạt động:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model 'gpt5' not found",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "model",
    "code": "model_not_found",
    "did_you_mean": "gpt-4o",
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o"},
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Did you mean 'gpt-4o'? Use GET /v1/models to list all available models."
  }
}
```

Việc phân giải `did_you_mean` sử dụng:
1. Ánh xạ alias tĩnh (từ dữ liệu lỗi thực tế)
2. Khớp chuỗi chuẩn hóa (loại bỏ dấu gạch ngang, không phân biệt chữ hoa chữ thường)
3. Khớp khoảng cách chỉnh sửa (ngưỡng ≤ 3)

### insufficient_balance (402)

Khi số dư tài khoản quá thấp so với chi phí ước tính:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200.",
    "type": "insufficient_balance",
    "code": "insufficient_balance",
    "balance_usd": 0.12,
    "estimated_cost_usd": 0.35,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "deepseek-chat"}
    ],
    "hint": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200. Try a cheaper model, or top up at https://lemondata.cc/dashboard/billing."
  }
}
```

`suggestions` chứa các mô hình rẻ hơn chi phí ước tính mà agent có thể chuyển sang.

### all_channels_failed (503)

Khi tất cả các kênh upstream cho một mô hình không khả dụng:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model claude-opus-4-6 temporarily unavailable",
    "code": "all_channels_failed",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 30,
    "alternatives": [
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5", "status": "available", "tags": []},
      {"id": "gpt-4o", "status": "available", "tags": []}
    ],
    "hint": "All channels for 'claude-opus-4-6' are temporarily unavailable. Retry in 30s or try an alternative model."
  }
}
```

<Note>
`retryable` là `false` khi lý do là `no_channels` (không có kênh nào được cấu hình cho mô hình này). Nó chỉ là `true` đối với các lỗi tạm thời như ngắt mạch (circuit breaker) hoặc hết hạn mức (quota).
</Note>

### rate_limit_exceeded (429)

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Rate limit: 60 rpm exceeded",
    "type": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "code": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 8,
    "hint": "Rate limited. Retry after 8s. Current limit: 60/min for user role."
  }
}
```

Giá trị `retry_after` được tính toán từ thời gian đặt lại cửa sổ giới hạn tốc độ thực tế.

<Note>
Các endpoint tương thích với OpenAI sử dụng các loại lỗi công khai ổn định của LemonData như `rate_limit_exceeded`, `upstream_error`, và `all_channels_failed`. Các endpoint tương thích với Anthropic và Gemini sử dụng cấu trúc phản hồi gốc của riêng chúng.
</Note>

### context_length_exceeded (400)

Khi đầu vào vượt quá cửa sổ ngữ cảnh của mô hình (lỗi upstream, được bổ sung thêm các gợi ý):

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "This model's maximum context length is 128000 tokens...",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "code": "context_length_exceeded",
    "retryable": false,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gemini-2.5-pro"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Reduce your input or switch to a model with a larger context window."
  }
}
```

## Native Endpoint Headers

Khi bạn gọi `/v1/chat/completions` với một mô hình có endpoint gốc (Anthropic hoặc Gemini), **phản hồi thành công** sẽ bao gồm các header tối ưu hóa:

```
X-LemonData-Hint: This model supports native Anthropic format. Use POST /v1/messages for better performance (no format conversion).
X-LemonData-Native-Endpoint: /v1/messages
```

| Nhà cung cấp mô hình | Endpoint đề xuất | Lợi ích |
|---------------|-------------------|---------|
| Anthropic (Claude) | `/v1/messages` | Không chuyển đổi định dạng, suy nghĩ mở rộng, prompt caching |
| Google (Gemini) | `/v1beta/gemini` | Không chuyển đổi định dạng, grounding, thiết lập an toàn |
| OpenAI | — | Chat completions đã là định dạng gốc |

Các header này xuất hiện trên cả phản hồi streaming và non-streaming.

## Các cải tiến cho /v1/models

Ba trường mới trong phần mở rộng `lemondata` của mỗi đối tượng mô hình:

```json
{
  "id": "gpt-4o",
  "lemondata": {
    "category": "chat",
    "pricing_unit": "per_token",
    "cache_pricing": {
      "cache_read_per_1m": "1.25",
      "cache_write_per_1m": "2.50",
      "platform_cache_discount": 0.9
    }
  }
}
```

| Trường | Giá trị | Mô tả |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `category` | `chat`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `tts`, `stt`, `3d`, `embedding`, `rerank` | Loại mô hình |
| `pricing_unit` | `per_token`, `per_image`, `per_second`, `per_request` | Cách mô hình được tính phí |
| `cache_pricing` | đối tượng hoặc `null` | Giá prompt cache upstream + chiết khấu semantic cache của nền tảng |

### Lọc theo danh mục

```bash
GET /v1/models?category=chat          # Chỉ các mô hình Chat
GET /v1/models?category=image         # Các mô hình tạo hình ảnh
GET /v1/models?tag=coding&category=chat  # Các mô hình chat được tối ưu hóa cho lập trình
```

## llms.txt

Bản tóm tắt API có thể đọc được bằng máy có sẵn tại:

```
GET https://api.lemondata.cc/llms.txt
```

Nó bao gồm:
- Template cho lần gọi đầu tiên với ví dụ thực tế
- Tên các mô hình phổ biến (được tạo động từ dữ liệu sử dụng)
- Tất cả 12 API endpoint
- Các tham số lọc để khám phá mô hình
- Hướng dẫn xử lý lỗi

Các AI agent đọc `llms.txt` trước lần gọi API đầu tiên thường có thể thành công ngay trong lần thử đầu tiên.

## Sử dụng trong mã nguồn Agent

### Python (OpenAI SDK)

```python
from openai import OpenAI, BadRequestError

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="sk-your-key",
    base_url="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
)

def smart_chat(messages, model="gpt-4o"):
    try:
        return client.chat.completions.create(
            model=model, messages=messages
        )
    except BadRequestError as e:
        error = e.body.get("error", {}) if isinstance(e.body, dict) else {}
        # Sử dụng did_you_mean để tự động sửa lỗi
        if error.get("code") == "model_not_found" and error.get("did_you_mean"):
            return client.chat.completions.create(
                model=error["did_you_mean"], messages=messages
            )
        raise
```

### JavaScript (OpenAI SDK)

```javascript
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const client = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: 'sk-your-key',
  baseURL: 'https://api.lemondata.cc/v1'
});

async function smartChat(messages, model = 'gpt-4o') {
  try {
    return await client.chat.completions.create({ model, messages });
  } catch (error) {
    const err = error?.error;
    if (err?.code === 'model_not_found' && err?.did_you_mean) {
      return client.chat.completions.create({
        model: err.did_you_mean, messages
      });
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## Nguyên tắc thiết kế

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Thất bại nhanh, thất bại có thông tin" icon="bolt">
    Lỗi được trả về ngay lập tức với tất cả dữ liệu mà agent cần để tự sửa lỗi.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Không tự động điều hướng" icon="route">
    API không bao giờ âm thầm thay thế bằng một mô hình khác. Agent sẽ quyết định.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Đề xuất dựa trên dữ liệu" icon="database">
    Tất cả các đề xuất đều đến từ dữ liệu thực tế, không phải từ danh sách được viết cứng.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Tương thích ngược" icon="plug">
    Tất cả các trường gợi ý là tùy chọn. Các client hiện tại sẽ không thấy sự khác biệt.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

---
title: "✨ API Agent-First"
description: "Petunjuk kesalahan terstruktur untuk agen AI agar dapat melakukan koreksi mandiri pada percobaan ulang pertama"
---

## Gambaran Umum

API Agent-First LemonData memperkaya respons kesalahan dengan petunjuk terstruktur yang dapat diurai dan ditindaklanjuti oleh agen AI secara langsung — tanpa pencarian web, tanpa pencarian dokumentasi, tanpa tebakan.

Setiap respons kesalahan menyertakan bidang opsional seperti `did_you_mean`, `suggestions`, `hint`, `retryable`, dan `retry_after` di dalam objek `error` standar. Bidang-bidang ini kompatibel ke belakang — klien yang tidak menggunakannya tidak akan melihat perbedaan.

## Bidang Petunjuk Kesalahan

Semua bidang petunjuk adalah ekstensi opsional di dalam objek `error`:

| Bidang | Tipe | Deskripsi |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `did_you_mean` | `string` | Nama model yang paling mendekati |
| `suggestions` | `array` | Model yang direkomendasikan dengan metadata |
| `alternatives` | `array` | Model alternatif yang saat ini tersedia |
| `hint` | `string` | Panduan langkah selanjutnya yang dapat dibaca oleh manusia/agen |
| `retryable` | `boolean` | Apakah mencoba ulang permintaan yang sama mungkin berhasil |
| `retry_after` | `number` | Detik untuk menunggu sebelum mencoba ulang |
| `balance_usd` | `number` | Saldo akun saat ini dalam USD |
| `estimated_cost_usd` | `number` | Estimasi biaya dari permintaan yang gagal |

## Contoh Kode Kesalahan

### model_not_found (400)

Ketika nama model tidak cocok dengan model aktif apa pun:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model 'gpt5' not found",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "model",
    "code": "model_not_found",
    "did_you_mean": "gpt-4o",
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o"},
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Did you mean 'gpt-4o'? Use GET /v1/models to list all available models."
  }
}
```

Resolusi `did_you_mean` menggunakan:
1. Pemetaan alias statis (dari data kesalahan produksi)
2. Pencocokan string yang dinormalisasi (menghapus tanda hubung, tidak peka huruf besar-kecil)
3. Pencocokan jarak edit (ambang batas ≤ 3)

### insufficient_balance (402)

Ketika saldo akun terlalu rendah untuk estimasi biaya:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200.",
    "type": "insufficient_balance",
    "code": "insufficient_balance",
    "balance_usd": 0.12,
    "estimated_cost_usd": 0.35,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "deepseek-chat"}
    ],
    "hint": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200. Try a cheaper model, or top up at https://lemondata.cc/dashboard/billing."
  }
}
```

`suggestions` berisi model yang lebih murah daripada estimasi biaya yang dapat dialihkan oleh agen.

### all_channels_failed (503)

Ketika semua saluran upstream untuk sebuah model tidak tersedia:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model claude-opus-4-6 temporarily unavailable",
    "code": "all_channels_failed",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 30,
    "alternatives": [
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5", "status": "available", "tags": []},
      {"id": "gpt-4o", "status": "available", "tags": []}
    ],
    "hint": "All channels for 'claude-opus-4-6' are temporarily unavailable. Retry in 30s or try an alternative model."
  }
}
```

<Note>
`retryable` bernilai `false` ketika alasannya adalah `no_channels` (tidak ada saluran yang dikonfigurasi untuk model ini). Bernilai `true` hanya untuk kegagalan sementara seperti pemutusan sirkuit (circuit breaker) atau kuota yang habis.
</Note>

### rate_limit_exceeded (429)

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Rate limit: 60 rpm exceeded",
    "type": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "code": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 8,
    "hint": "Rate limited. Retry after 8s. Current limit: 60/min for user role."
  }
}
```

Nilai `retry_after` dihitung dari waktu reset jendela batas laju (rate limit) yang sebenarnya.

<Note>
Endpoint yang kompatibel dengan OpenAI menggunakan tipe kesalahan publik LemonData yang stabil seperti `rate_limit_exceeded`, `upstream_error`, dan `all_channels_failed`. Endpoint yang kompatibel dengan Anthropic dan Gemini menggunakan bentuk respons asli mereka sendiri.
</Note>

### context_length_exceeded (400)

Ketika input melebihi jendela konteks model (kesalahan upstream, diperkaya dengan petunjuk):

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "This model's maximum context length is 128000 tokens...",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "code": "context_length_exceeded",
    "retryable": false,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gemini-2.5-pro"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Reduce your input or switch to a model with a larger context window."
  }
}
```

## Header Endpoint Asli

Saat Anda memanggil `/v1/chat/completions` dengan model yang memiliki endpoint asli (Anthropic atau Gemini), **respons sukses** menyertakan header optimasi:

```
X-LemonData-Hint: This model supports native Anthropic format. Use POST /v1/messages for better performance (no format conversion).
X-LemonData-Native-Endpoint: /v1/messages
```

| Penyedia Model | Endpoint yang Disarankan | Manfaat |
|---------------|-------------------|---------|
| Anthropic (Claude) | `/v1/messages` | Tanpa konversi format, extended thinking, prompt caching |
| Google (Gemini) | `/v1beta/gemini` | Tanpa konversi format, grounding, pengaturan keamanan |
| OpenAI | — | Chat completions sudah merupakan format asli |

Header ini muncul pada respons streaming maupun non-streaming.

## Peningkatan /v1/models

Tiga bidang baru dalam ekstensi `lemondata` dari setiap objek model:

```json
{
  "id": "gpt-4o",
  "lemondata": {
    "category": "chat",
    "pricing_unit": "per_token",
    "cache_pricing": {
      "cache_read_per_1m": "1.25",
      "cache_write_per_1m": "2.50",
      "platform_cache_discount": 0.9
    }
  }
}
```

| Bidang | Nilai | Deskripsi |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `category` | `chat`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `tts`, `stt`, `3d`, `embedding`, `rerank` | Tipe model |
| `pricing_unit` | `per_token`, `per_image`, `per_second`, `per_request` | Bagaimana model ditagih |
| `cache_pricing` | objek atau `null` | Harga prompt cache upstream + diskon semantic cache platform |

### Pemfilteran Kategori

```bash
GET /v1/models?category=chat          # Hanya model chat
GET /v1/models?category=image         # Model pembuatan gambar
GET /v1/models?tag=coding&category=chat  # Model chat yang dioptimalkan untuk pengodean
```

## llms.txt

Ringkasan API yang dapat dibaca mesin tersedia di:

```
GET https://api.lemondata.cc/llms.txt
```

Ini mencakup:
- Templat panggilan pertama dengan contoh yang berfungsi
- Nama model umum (dihasilkan secara dinamis dari data penggunaan)
- Semua 12 endpoint API
- Parameter filter untuk penemuan model
- Panduan penanganan kesalahan

Agen AI yang membaca `llms.txt` sebelum panggilan API pertama mereka biasanya dapat berhasil pada percobaan pertama.

## Penggunaan dalam Kode Agen

### Python (OpenAI SDK)

```python
from openai import OpenAI, BadRequestError

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="sk-your-key",
    base_url="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
)

def smart_chat(messages, model="gpt-4o"):
    try:
        return client.chat.completions.create(
            model=model, messages=messages
        )
    except BadRequestError as e:
        error = e.body.get("error", {}) if isinstance(e.body, dict) else {}
        # Gunakan did_you_mean untuk koreksi otomatis
        if error.get("code") == "model_not_found" and error.get("did_you_mean"):
            return client.chat.completions.create(
                model=error["did_you_mean"], messages=messages
            )
        raise
```

### JavaScript (OpenAI SDK)

```javascript
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const client = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: 'sk-your-key',
  baseURL: 'https://api.lemondata.cc/v1'
});

async function smartChat(messages, model = 'gpt-4o') {
  try {
    return await client.chat.completions.create({ model, messages });
  } catch (error) {
    const err = error?.error;
    if (err?.code === 'model_not_found' && err?.did_you_mean) {
      return client.chat.completions.create({
        model: err.did_you_mean, messages
      });
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## Prinsip Desain

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Gagal cepat, gagal informatif" icon="bolt">
    Kesalahan segera kembali dengan semua data yang dibutuhkan agen untuk melakukan koreksi mandiri.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Tanpa perutean otomatis" icon="route">
    API tidak pernah mengganti model lain secara diam-diam. Agen yang memutuskan.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Saran berbasis data" icon="database">
    Semua rekomendasi berasal dari data produksi, bukan daftar yang dikodekan secara kaku.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Kompatibel ke belakang" icon="plug">
    Semua bidang petunjuk bersifat opsional. Klien yang ada tidak melihat perbedaan.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

---
title: "✨ Agent-First API"
description: "Yapay zeka agent'larının ilk yeniden denemede kendilerini düzeltebilmeleri için yapılandırılmış hata ipuçları"
---

## Genel Bakış

LemonData'nın Agent-First API'si, hata yanıtlarını yapay zeka agent'larının anında ayrıştırabileceği ve üzerinde işlem yapabileceği yapılandırılmış ipuçlarıyla zenginleştirir — web araması yok, doküman incelemesi yok, tahmin yürütmek yok.

Her hata yanıtı, standart `error` nesnesi içinde `did_you_mean`, `suggestions`, `hint`, `retryable` ve `retry_after` gibi isteğe bağlı alanlar içerir. Bu alanlar geriye dönük uyumludur — bunları kullanmayan istemciler hiçbir fark görmez.

## Hata İpucu Alanları

Tüm ipucu alanları, `error` nesnesi içindeki isteğe bağlı uzantılardır:

| Alan | Tip | Açıklama |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `did_you_mean` | `string` | En yakın eşleşen model adı |
| `suggestions` | `array` | Meta verilerle birlikte önerilen modeller |
| `alternatives` | `array` | Şu anda mevcut olan alternatif modeller |
| `hint` | `string` | İnsan/agent tarafından okunabilir sonraki adım rehberliği |
| `retryable` | `boolean` | Aynı isteğin yeniden denenmesinin başarılı olup olmayacağı |
| `retry_after` | `number` | Yeniden denemeden önce beklenecek saniye |
| `balance_usd` | `number` | USD cinsinden mevcut hesap bakiyesi |
| `estimated_cost_usd` | `number` | Başarısız olan isteğin tahmini maliyeti |

## Hata Kodu Örnekleri

### model_not_found (400)

Bir model adı herhangi bir aktif modelle eşleşmediğinde:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model 'gpt5' not found",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "model",
    "code": "model_not_found",
    "did_you_mean": "gpt-4o",
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o"},
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Did you mean 'gpt-4o'? Use GET /v1/models to list all available models."
  }
}
```

`did_you_mean` çözümü şunları kullanır:
1. Statik takma ad eşlemesi (üretim hata verilerinden)
2. Normalleştirilmiş dize eşleştirme (tireleri kaldırır, büyük/küçük harfe duyarsızdır)
3. Düzenleme mesafesi (edit distance) eşleştirme (eşik ≤ 3)

### insufficient_balance (402)

Hesap bakiyesi tahmini maliyet için çok düşük olduğunda:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200.",
    "type": "insufficient_balance",
    "code": "insufficient_balance",
    "balance_usd": 0.12,
    "estimated_cost_usd": 0.35,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gpt-4o-mini"},
      {"id": "deepseek-chat"}
    ],
    "hint": "Insufficient balance: need ~$0.3500 for claude-sonnet-4-5, but balance is $0.1200. Try a cheaper model, or top up at https://lemondata.cc/dashboard/billing."
  }
}
```

`suggestions`, agent'ın geçiş yapabileceği, tahmini maliyetten daha ucuz modelleri içerir.

### all_channels_failed (503)

Bir model için tüm üst akış (upstream) kanalları kullanılamaz olduğunda:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Model claude-opus-4-6 temporarily unavailable",
    "code": "all_channels_failed",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 30,
    "alternatives": [
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5", "status": "available", "tags": []},
      {"id": "gpt-4o", "status": "available", "tags": []}
    ],
    "hint": "All channels for 'claude-opus-4-6' are temporarily unavailable. Retry in 30s or try an alternative model."
  }
}
```

<Note>
`retryable`, neden `no_channels` (bu model için yapılandırılmış kanal yok) olduğunda `false` değerini alır. Yalnızca devre kesici (circuit breaker) tetiklenmesi veya kota tükenmesi gibi geçici hatalar için `true` olur.
</Note>

### rate_limit_exceeded (429)

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Rate limit: 60 rpm exceeded",
    "type": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "code": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 8,
    "hint": "Rate limited. Retry after 8s. Current limit: 60/min for user role."
  }
}
```

`retry_after` değeri, gerçek hız sınırı (rate limit) penceresi sıfırlama süresinden hesaplanır.

<Note>
OpenAI uyumlu uç noktalar, `rate_limit_exceeded`, `upstream_error` ve `all_channels_failed` gibi LemonData'nın kararlı genel hata türlerini kullanır. Anthropic uyumlu ve Gemini uyumlu uç noktalar kendi yerel (native) yanıt biçimlerini kullanır.
</Note>

### context_length_exceeded (400)

Girdi, modelin bağlam penceresini (context window) aştığında (ipuçlarıyla zenginleştirilmiş üst akış hatası):

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "This model's maximum context length is 128000 tokens...",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "code": "context_length_exceeded",
    "retryable": false,
    "suggestions": [
      {"id": "gemini-2.5-pro"},
      {"id": "claude-sonnet-4-5"}
    ],
    "hint": "Reduce your input or switch to a model with a larger context window."
  }
}
```

## Yerel Uç Nokta Başlıkları

Yerel bir uç noktası (Anthropic veya Gemini) olan bir modelle `/v1/chat/completions` çağrısı yaptığınızda, **başarılı yanıt** optimizasyon başlıklarını içerir:

```
X-LemonData-Hint: This model supports native Anthropic format. Use POST /v1/messages for better performance (no format conversion).
X-LemonData-Native-Endpoint: /v1/messages
```

| Model Sağlayıcısı | Önerilen Uç Nokta | Avantaj |
|---------------|-------------------|---------|
| Anthropic (Claude) | `/v1/messages` | Format dönüştürme yok, genişletilmiş düşünme (extended thinking), istem önbelleğe alma (prompt caching) |
| Google (Gemini) | `/v1beta/gemini` | Format dönüştürme yok, dayanaklandırma (grounding), güvenlik ayarları |
| OpenAI | — | Chat completions zaten yerel formattır |

Bu başlıklar hem akışlı (streaming) hem de akışsız yanıtlarda görünür.

## /v1/models İyileştirmeleri

Her model nesnesinin `lemondata` uzantısındaki üç yeni alan:

```json
{
  "id": "gpt-4o",
  "lemondata": {
    "category": "chat",
    "pricing_unit": "per_token",
    "cache_pricing": {
      "cache_read_per_1m": "1.25",
      "cache_write_per_1m": "2.50",
      "platform_cache_discount": 0.9
    }
  }
}
```

| Alan | Değerler | Açıklama |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `category` | `chat`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `tts`, `stt`, `3d`, `embedding`, `rerank` | Model tipi |
| `pricing_unit` | `per_token`, `per_image`, `per_second`, `per_request` | Modelin nasıl faturalandırıldığı |
| `cache_pricing` | nesne veya `null` | Üst akış istem önbelleği (prompt cache) fiyatları + platform semantik önbellek indirimi |

### Kategori Filtreleme

```bash
GET /v1/models?category=chat          # Yalnızca sohbet modelleri
GET /v1/models?category=image         # Görüntü oluşturma modelleri
GET /v1/models?tag=coding&category=chat  # Kodlama için optimize edilmiş sohbet modelleri
```

## llms.txt

Makine tarafından okunabilir bir API genel bakışı şu adreste mevcuttur:

```
GET https://api.lemondata.cc/llms.txt
```

Şunları içerir:
- Çalışan bir örnekle ilk çağrı şablonu
- Yaygın model adları (kullanım verilerinden dinamik olarak oluşturulur)
- Tüm 12 API uç noktası
- Model keşfi için filtre parametreleri
- Hata yönetimi rehberliği

İlk API çağrılarından önce `llms.txt` dosyasını okuyan yapay zeka agent'ları genellikle ilk denemede başarılı olabilir.

## Agent Kodunda Kullanım

### Python (OpenAI SDK)

```python
from openai import OpenAI, BadRequestError

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="sk-your-key",
    base_url="https://api.lemondata.cc/v1"
)

def smart_chat(messages, model="gpt-4o"):
    try:
        return client.chat.completions.create(
            model=model, messages=messages
        )
    except BadRequestError as e:
        error = e.body.get("error", {}) if isinstance(e.body, dict) else {}
        # Otomatik düzeltme için did_you_mean kullanın
        if error.get("code") == "model_not_found" and error.get("did_you_mean"):
            return client.chat.completions.create(
                model=error["did_you_mean"], messages=messages
            )
        raise
```

### JavaScript (OpenAI SDK)

```javascript
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const client = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: 'sk-your-key',
  baseURL: 'https://api.lemondata.cc/v1'
});

async function smartChat(messages, model = 'gpt-4o') {
  try {
    return await client.chat.completions.create({ model, messages });
  } catch (error) {
    const err = error?.error;
    if (err?.code === 'model_not_found' && err?.did_you_mean) {
      return client.chat.completions.create({
        model: err.did_you_mean, messages
      });
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## 概要

## 概要

このエンドポイントは、LemonDataのOpenAI互換バッチAPIの一部です。バッチジョブはアップロードされたJSONLファイルを使用し、非同期で実行され、後で出力/エラーファイルを返すことができます。

## 注意事項

- バッチ入力ファイルは`purpose=batch`を使用する必要があります。
- `completion_window`は現在`24h`です。
- 出力の順序は保証されていません; 常に`custom_id`で一致させてください。
- バッチアイテム内でのストリーミングはサポートされていません。

## リクエスト / レスポンス

正確なスキーマについては、上のインタラクティブなOpenAPIパネルを使用してください。

## 操作のヒント

- 冪等性のある下流の調整には`custom_id`を使用してください。
- ワーカーがバッチを最終化した後にのみ`output_file_id`と`error_file_id`を期待してください。
- バッチの価格は、`isBatchRequest=true`の割引ルールが適用されるため、同期価格とは異なる場合があります。

- Batch-Eingabedateien müssen `purpose=batch` verwenden.

translations.zh:
---
title: "自托管安装"
description: "在您自己的服务器上运行 LemonClaw 并配合 LemonData AI API —— 一键安装，无需 Docker"
---

<Note>
**自托管**意味着您直接在自己的 VPS 或机器上运行 LemonClaw。您只需通过 LemonData 余额支付 AI 模型的使用费用 —— 无需支付实例费。
</Note>

<Tip>
更喜欢托管设置？[创建一个 Claw 实例](/claw/introduction) 即可获得相同的 LemonClaw 运行时和 WebUI，而无需自行管理服务器。
</Tip>

## 快速安装

<CodeGroup>
```bash Linux / macOS
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw/main/deploy/self-hosted/install.sh | bash
```

```bash Non-interactive
LEMONDATA_API_KEY=sk-xxx curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw/main/deploy/self-hosted/install.sh | bash
```
</CodeGroup>

安装程序将提示您输入 **LemonData API Key**。您可以从 [控制面板](https://lemondata.cc/dashboard) 获取。

## 安装内容

<Steps>
  <Step title="Node.js 22+">
    如果缺失则自动安装（Linux 通过 NodeSource，macOS 通过 Homebrew）
  </Step>
  <Step title="LemonClaw">
    预配置了 LemonData API 的 LemonClaw 软件包
  </Step>
  <Step title="15 个 AI 模型">
    Claude、GPT-5、Gemini、DeepSeek 等 —— 开箱即用
  </Step>
  <Step title="IM 插件">
    预装了钉钉、企业微信和 QQ 插件
  </Step>
  <Step title="系统服务">
    开机自启动（Linux 使用 systemd，macOS 使用 launchd）
  </Step>
</Steps>

## 系统要求

| 要求 | 详情 |
|-------------|---------|
| **操作系统** | Linux (Ubuntu/Debian/CentOS/RHEL) 或 macOS |
| **架构** | x64 或 arm64 |
| **内存** | 最小 1 GB，推荐 2 GB |
| **API Key** | [在此获取](https://lemondata.cc) |

## 安装完成后

安装程序将输出您的访问凭据：

```
✓ LemonClaw installed successfully!

  WebUI:        http://your-ip:18789
  Token:        your-gateway-token
  Auto-login:   http://your-ip:18789?token=your-gateway-token
  Model:        claude-sonnet-4-6
```

<Warning>
**请保存您的 token！** 您需要它来访问 WebUI 并连接即时通讯平台。
</Warning>

## 连接即时通讯平台

使用您的 token 访问 WebUI（地址为 `http://your-ip:18789`），然后按照特定平台的指南进行操作：

<Note>
本节中的平台指南涵盖了托管 Claw 实例和自托管 LemonClaw 安装所使用的相同 LemonClaw WebUI。如果指南中提到了 Claw 控制面板，自托管用户应直接打开自己的 WebUI。
</Note>

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Telegram" icon="paper-plane" href="/claw/telegram" />
  <Card title="Discord" icon="discord" href="/claw/discord" />
  <Card title="WhatsApp" icon="whatsapp" href="/claw/whatsapp" />
  <Card title="Slack" icon="slack" href="/claw/slack" />
  <Card title="钉钉" icon="bell" href="/claw/dingtalk" />
  <Card title="企业微信" icon="building" href="/claw/wecom" />
</CardGroup>

## 管理命令

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Linux">
    ```bash
    systemctl --user status lemonclaw    # 查看状态
    journalctl --user -u lemonclaw -f    # 查看日志
    systemctl --user restart lemonclaw   # 重启
    systemctl --user stop lemonclaw      # 停止
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="macOS">
    ```bash
    tail -f ~/.lemonclaw/lemonclaw.log    # 查看日志
    launchctl stop cc.lemondata.lemonclaw && launchctl start cc.lemondata.lemonclaw  # 重启
    launchctl stop cc.lemondata.lemonclaw  # 停止
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## 配置

配置文件位置：`~/.lemonclaw/config.json`

编辑后，重启服务以应用更改。

### 更改默认模型

```json
{
  "agents": {
    "defaults": {
      "model": {
        "primary": "lemondata-claude/claude-opus-4-6"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

可用的模型前缀：
- `lemondata-claude/` — Claude 模型 (anthropic-messages API)
- `lemondata-minimax/` — MiniMax 模型 (anthropic-messages API)
- `lemondata/` — 所有其他模型 (openai-completions API)

## 升级

```bash
# 重新运行安装程序以升级到最新版本
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw/main/deploy/self-hosted/install.sh | bash
# 然后重启服务
systemctl --user restart lemonclaw  # Linux
# 或
launchctl stop cc.lemondata.lemonclaw && launchctl start cc.lemondata.lemonclaw  # macOS
```

## 卸载

```bash
# 停止并禁用服务
systemctl --user stop lemonclaw && systemctl --user disable lemonclaw  # Linux
launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/cc.lemondata.lemonclaw.plist  # macOS

# 移除 LemonClaw
rm -rf ~/.lemonclaw
```

## 自托管 vs 托管

| | 自托管 | 托管 (Claw) |
|---|---|---|
| **实例费用** | 免费 | $20 / 30 天 |
| **AI 使用费** | 按需付费 | 按需付费 |
| **基础设施** | 您的服务器 | 我们管理一切 |
| **更新** | 手动（重新运行安装程序） | 自动 |
| **支持** | 社区 | 优先 |

<Info>
**源代码**：[github.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw](https://github.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw)
</Info>

```
  Auto-login:   http://your-ip:18789?token=your-gateway-token
```


<Warning>
**Salve seu token!** Você precisará dele para acessar a WebUI e conectar plataformas de mensagens.
</Warning>

## Conectar Plataformas de Mensagens

Acesse a WebUI em `http://your-ip:18789` com seu token e siga os guias específicos de cada plataforma:

<Note>
Os guias de plataforma nesta seção cobrem a mesma WebUI do LemonClaw usada tanto por instâncias Claw hospedadas quanto por instalações LemonClaw self-hosted. Se um guia mencionar o Claw Dashboard, usuários de self-hosted devem abrir sua própria WebUI diretamente.
</Note>

  <Card title="DingTalk" icon="bell" href="/claw/dingtalk" />
  <Card title="WeCom" icon="building" href="/claw/wecom" />
</CardGroup>

## Comandos de Gerenciamento

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Linux">
    ```bash
    systemctl --user status lemonclaw    # Verificar status
    journalctl --user -u lemonclaw -f    # Visualizar logs
    systemctl --user restart lemonclaw   # Reiniciar
    systemctl --user stop lemonclaw      # Parar
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="macOS">
    ```bash
    tail -f ~/.lemonclaw/lemonclaw.log    # Visualizar logs
    launchctl stop cc.lemondata.lemonclaw && launchctl start cc.lemondata.lemonclaw  # Reiniciar
    launchctl stop cc.lemondata.lemonclaw  # Parar
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Configuração

Localização do arquivo de configuração: `~/.lemonclaw/config.json`

Após editar, reinicie o serviço para aplicar as alterações.

### Alterar Modelo Padrão

```json
{
  "agents": {
    "defaults": {
      "model": {
        "primary": "lemondata-claude/claude-opus-4-6"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Prefixos de modelos disponíveis:
- `lemondata-claude/` — Modelos Claude (API anthropic-messages)
- `lemondata-minimax/` — Modelos MiniMax (API anthropic-messages)
- `lemondata/` — Todos os outros modelos (API openai-completions)

## Atualização

```bash
# Execute o instalador novamente para atualizar para a versão mais recente
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw/main/deploy/self-hosted/install.sh | bash
# Em seguida, reinicie o serviço
systemctl --user restart lemonclaw  # Linux
# ou
launchctl stop cc.lemondata.lemonclaw && launchctl start cc.lemondata.lemonclaw  # macOS
```

## Desinstalação

```bash
# Parar e desativar o serviço
systemctl --user stop lemonclaw && systemctl --user disable lemonclaw  # Linux
launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/cc.lemondata.lemonclaw.plist  # macOS

# Remover o LemonClaw
rm -rf ~/.lemonclaw
```

## Self-Hosted vs Gerenciado

| | Self-Hosted | Gerenciado (Claw) |
|---|---|---|
| **Custo da instância** | Grátis | $20 / 30 dias |
| **Uso de IA** | Pagamento por uso | Pagamento por uso |
| **Infraestrutura** | Seu servidor | Nós gerenciamos tudo |
| **Atualizações** | Manual (reexecutar instalador) | Automático |
| **Suporte** | Comunidade | Prioridade |

<Info>
**Código-fonte**: [github.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw](https://github.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw)

## Perintah Manajemen

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Linux">

## Konfigurasi

### Ubah Model Default

```json
{
  "agents": {
    "defaults": {
      "model": {
        "primary": "lemondata-claude/claude-opus-4-6"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Prefix model yang tersedia:
- `lemondata-claude/` — Model Claude (anthropic-messages API)
- `lemondata-minimax/` — Model MiniMax (anthropic-messages API)
- `lemondata/` — Semua model lainnya (openai-completions API)

## Pembaruan

```bash
# Re-run the installer to upgrade to the latest version
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw/main/deploy/self-hosted/install.sh | bash
# Then restart the service
systemctl --user restart lemonclaw  # Linux
# or
launchctl stop cc.lemondata.lemonclaw && launchctl start cc.lemondata.lemonclaw  # macOS
```

## Hapus Instalasi

```bash
# Stop and disable service
systemctl --user stop lemonclaw && systemctl --user disable lemonclaw  # Linux
launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/cc.lemondata.lemonclaw.plist  # macOS

# Remove LemonClaw
rm -rf ~/.lemonclaw
```

## Self-Hosted vs Terkelola

| | Self-Hosted | Terkelola (Claw) |
|---|---|---|
| **Biaya instans** | Gratis | $20 / 30 hari |
| **Penggunaan AI** | Bayar sesuai penggunaan | Bayar sesuai penggunaan |
| **Infrastruktur** | Server Anda | Kami mengelola segalanya |
| **Pembaruan** | Manual (jalankan ulang installer) | Otomatis |
| **Dukungan** | Komunitas | Prioritas |

**Kode sumber**: [github.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw](https://github.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw)

<Note>
**Self-hosted** (kendi sunucunda barındırma), LemonClaw'ı doğrudan kendi VPS'inizde veya makinenizde çalıştırmanız anlamına gelir. Yalnızca LemonData bakiyeniz üzerinden AI model kullanımı için ödeme yaparsınız — örnek (instance) ücreti yoktur.
</Note>

<Tip>
Barındırılan bir kurulum mu tercih edersiniz? Sunucuları kendiniz yönetmek zorunda kalmadan aynı LemonClaw çalışma zamanını ve WebUI'ı elde etmek için bir [Claw örneği oluşturun](/claw/introduction).
</Tip>

## Hızlı Kurulum

<CodeGroup>
```bash Linux / macOS
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw/main/deploy/self-hosted/install.sh | bash
```

```bash Etkileşimsiz
LEMONDATA_API_KEY=sk-xxx curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw/main/deploy/self-hosted/install.sh | bash
```
</CodeGroup>

Yükleyici sizden **LemonData API Key** isteyecektir. [Dashboard](https://lemondata.cc/dashboard) üzerinden bir tane edinin.

## Neler Kurulur

<Steps>
  <Step title="Node.js 22+">
    Eksikse otomatik olarak kurulur (Linux'ta NodeSource, macOS'ta Homebrew aracılığıyla)
  </Step>
  <Step title="LemonClaw">
    LemonData API ile önceden yapılandırılmış LemonClaw paketi
  </Step>
  <Step title="15 AI Modeli">
    Claude, GPT-5, Gemini, DeepSeek ve daha fazlası — kullanıma hazır
  </Step>
  <Step title="IM Eklentileri">
    DingTalk, WeCom ve QQ eklentileri önceden yüklenmiş
  </Step>
  <Step title="Sistem Servisi">
    Açılışta otomatik başlar (Linux'ta systemd, macOS'ta launchd)
  </Step>
</Steps>

|-------------|---------|
| **İşletim Sistemi** | Linux (Ubuntu/Debian/CentOS/RHEL) veya macOS |
| **Mimari** | x64 veya arm64 |
| **RAM** | Minimum 1 GB, 2 GB önerilir |
| **API Key** | [Buradan edinin](https://lemondata.cc) |

## Yapılandırma

Yapılandırma dosyası konumu: `~/.lemonclaw/config.json`

Düzenledikten sonra, değişiklikleri uygulamak için servisi yeniden başlatın.

### Varsayılan Modeli Değiştir

```json
{
  "agents": {
    "defaults": {
      "model": {
        "primary": "lemondata-claude/claude-opus-4-6"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Mevcut model önekleri:
- `lemondata-claude/` — Claude modelleri (anthropic-messages API)
- `lemondata-minimax/` — MiniMax modelleri (anthropic-messages API)
- `lemondata/` — Diğer tüm modeller (openai-completions API)

## Yükseltme

```bash
# En son sürüme yükseltmek için yükleyiciyi yeniden çalıştırın
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hedging8563/lemonclaw/main/deploy/self-hosted/install.sh | bash
# Ardından servisi yeniden başlatın
systemctl --user restart lemonclaw  # Linux
# veya
launchctl stop cc.lemondata.lemonclaw && launchctl start cc.lemondata.lemonclaw  # macOS
```

## Kaldırma

```bash

launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/cc.lemondata.lemonclaw.plist  # macOS

# LemonClaw'ı kaldır
rm -rf ~/.lemonclaw
```
